listing.title_text: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Nekretnine Crna Gora,Tivat-Predstavljamo vam novi rezidencijalni kompleks koji se nalazi u srcu Porto Montenegra, u kvartu Sinhro grada Tivta. Ovaj projekat nekretnina je magični spoj elegancije, udobnosti i najsavremenijeg dizajna, kreiran da ispuni sva vaša očekivanja i još mnogo toga.
Projekat obuhvata tri stambena bloka i krovni bazen koji povezuje dva odvojena bloka. Svaka zgrada ima luksuzne stanove i prostrane penthause, savršeno projektovane od najkvalitetnijih materijala.
Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.
Dodatno, na zahtjev klijenta, svaki apartman može biti u cjelosti opremljen najkvalitetnijim namještajem i ugradnim elementima. Trenutno postoje 2 posebne ponude:Prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora pre 1. juna 2025. godine, svaki apartman na poklon dobija parking mesto u podzemnoj garazi i individualnu ostavu.
Pri kupovini rezidencija 106, 108, 113, 403 i 404 - kompletno opremanje i namještaj na poklon!#NekretnineCrnaGora #Tivat #PortoMontenegro #PogledNaMore #Investicija #NovKompleksSaBazenom #LuksuzniStanovi #StanoviUIzgradnji
listing.description_text_en:
Real Estate Montenegro, Tivat - We present to you a new residential complex located in the heart of Porto Montenegro, in the Synchro district of the city of Tivat. This real estate project is a magical blend of elegance, comfort and state-of-the-art design, created to meet all your expectations and more.
The project includes three residential blocks and a rooftop swimming pool connecting two separate blocks. Each building has luxurious apartments and spacious penthouses, perfectly designed from the highest quality materials.
You can choose from 40 different apartments ranging from one bedroom 49m2 to fantastic penthouse apartments of 321m2.6 business units are also for sale.
Services and benefits:• Private concierge• Infinity pool on the roof• Private security• Underground garage• Dedicated storage units• Smart home systemThe basic package includes an elegant interior design, with the option of choosing between two styles - Italian and Nordic. Additionally, upon request, each apartment can be furnished and equipped with the highest quality furniture and equipment.
The complex is located next to the luxury marina for mega-yachts Porto Montenegro and in the immediate vicinity of international schools and airports in Tivat, Podgorica and Dubrovnik.
In addition to an award-winning marina, Porto Montenegro boasts a charming residential area, the five-star Regent Hotel, luxury boutiques, shops, restaurants, sports and recreational facilities, which attract a vibrant international community throughout the year.
Investing in security and prosperityBy investing in the project, you ensure a guaranteed return on invested funds of 6% per year. This is an opportunity for a smart investment, combining luxury with financial security.
Additionally, at the client's request, each apartment can be fully equipped with the highest quality furniture and built-in elements.
There are currently 2 special offers:When signing the sales contract before June 1, 2025, each apartment comes with a complimentary parking space in the underground garage and a private storage room.
For the purchase of residences 106, 108, 113, 403, and 404 – full furnishing and interior decoration included as a gift!#RealEstateMontenegro #Tivat #PortoMontenegro #SeaView #Investment #NewComplexWithPool #LuxuryApartments #ApartmentsUnderConstruction

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 225m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 225m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se penthouse povrsine 225.27m2 sa pogledom na more koji je lociran na 10. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok završetka: april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja:Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima i panoramskim pogledom koji spaja najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno je dostupno 66 apartmana za kupovinu, uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmane.
Kompleks poseduje dva ulaza – jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, smešten u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama.
Sadržaji kompleksa:Poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centarDva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko moreSpa centar sa bazenima i teretanomKonferencijski sadržajiPodzemni objekti: tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mestaUsluge i sigurnost:Konsijerž i 24-časovno obezbeđenje garantuju mir i sigurnostRaznovrsna ponuda hotela sa pet zvezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil životaZelena oaza:Ovaj savremeni objekat takođe nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gde ćete moći da uživate u prirodi. Poseban fokus je stavljen na održavanje zelenih površina, koje omogućavaju vlasnicima i gostima sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu.
Pogodnosti:Dva hotelska restorana, kafić, kancelarije i prodavnice na prvim spratovimaSpa centar sa teretanom i bazenimaZelena oaza na krovuBrendirane rezidencijeTehničke prostorije i podzemni parkingBrendirane rezidencije sa uslugom održavanjaPaketi nameštaja dostupni za useljenje
listing.description_text_en:
A penthouse of 225.27 m² with a sea view is for sale, located on the 10th floor of a complex under construction on the first line of the sea in Budva.
Completion date: April 2028Payment plan:Reservation: €10,000 (non-refundable)30% of the purchase price – within 10 days of signing the Preliminary AgreementThe remaining amount is paid in three installments:First installment 30% – after completion of the constructionSecond installment 30% – after completion of the finishing worksThird installment 10% – upon handover of the propertyThis unique complex is located in the very heart of tourist Budva, on the promenade, surrounded by fantastic natural conditions and panoramic views combining the best of the Budva Riviera with modern facilities, amenities, and 5-star hotel services.
Residential units available for sale are from the fourth to the ninth floor. These carefully designed apartments provide a perfect blend of luxury and functionality with stunning views of the surroundings. The 10th floor is exclusively dedicated to penthouses, boasting luxurious features such as jacuzzis and spacious terraces. In total, 66 apartments are available for purchase, including rooms, apartments, and penthouses.
The complex has two entrances – one conveniently located on the promenade, and another accessible from the boulevard. The main entrance, located in the congress center annex, provides easy access to various events and conferences.
Complex facilities:Commercial space, shops, and service centerTwo restaurants and a café with views of the Adriatic SeaSpa center with pools and gymConference facilitiesUnderground facilities: technical rooms and underground parking with a total of 160 parking spacesServices and security:Concierge and 24-hour security ensure peace and safetyA wide range of 5-star hotel amenities in Budva transforms your investment into a luxury lifestyleGreen oasis:This modern complex also offers a green oasis on the roof of the conference hall, allowing residents to enjoy nature. Special attention is given to maintaining green areas, enabling owners and guests to enjoy seasonal greenery and local flora right at their doorstep.
Amenities:Two hotel restaurants, café, offices, and shops on the lower floorsSpa center with gym and poolsGreen oasis on the roofBranded residencesTechnical rooms and underground parkingBranded residences with maintenance services

listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 119m², Krašići, Tivat
listing.description_text:
Na prodaju ekskluzivan duplex apartman ukupne površine 119 m², smešten u luksuznom boutique kompleksu The Cube u Krašićima, na poluostrvu Luštica. Ova moderna nekretnina pruža savršen spoj savremenog dizajna, privatnosti i vrhunskog kvaliteta života, uz spektakularan panoramski pogled na more i planine.
Kompleks se nalazi u mirnom delu Krašića i predstavlja jedinstvenu privatnu celinu sa svega 9 apartmana i 2 luksuzne vile, čime se obezbeđuje visok nivo komfora i ekskluzivnosti. Smešten je na odličnoj lokaciji, oko 15 minuta vožnje od Aerodroma Tivat i nekoliko minuta od prestižnog kompleksa Luštica Bay.
Apartman se prostire na dve etaže. Na prvom nivou nalazi se prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, gostinski toalet i izlaz na veliku terasu sa otvorenim panoramskim pogledom. Na drugom nivou smeštene su dve komforne spavaće sobe, pri čemu svaka soba poseduje svoje privatno kupatilo, pružajući dodatnu udobnost i privatnost. Na ovoj etaži se nalazi i tehnička prostorija sa veš mašinom, bojlerom i dodatnim prostorom za odlaganje.
Apartman je završen i spreman za useljenje. Projektovan je sa velikim staklenim površinama koje omogućavaju obilje prirodne svetlosti i nesmetan pogled na Jadransko more i okolne planine.
Stanari kompleksa imaju na raspolaganju zajednički bazen dužine 20 metara koji se održava tokom cele godine, kao i dve uređene lounge zone za odmor. Posebna prednost kompleksa je što vile imaju sopstvene bazene i garažna mesta, dok glavni bazen koriste isključivo vlasnici apartmana, što dodatno doprinosi privatnosti.
Nekretnina poseduje kompletnu dokumentaciju. Garažno parking mesto dostupno je uz doplatu.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is an exclusive duplex apartment with a total area of 119 m², located in the luxury boutique complex The Cube in Krasići, on the Lūštica Peninsula. This modern property offers a perfect blend of contemporary design, privacy, and a high quality of life, with a spectacular panoramic view of the sea and mountains.
The complex is situated in a peaceful area of Krasići and represents a unique private unit with only 9 apartments and 2 luxury villas, ensuring a high level of comfort and exclusivity. It is located in an excellent location, about 15 minutes by car from Tivat Airport and a few minutes from the prestigious Lūštica Bay complex.
The apartment spreads over two floors. On the ground floor there is a spacious living area with a kitchen and dining room, a guest toilet, and access to a large terrace with an open panoramic view. On the second floor there are two comfortable bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, providing additional convenience and privacy. There is also a utility room with a washing machine, boiler, and additional storage space on this floor.
The apartment is completed and ready for moving in. It is designed with large glass surfaces that allow plenty of natural light and an unobstructed view of the Adriatic Sea and the surrounding mountains.
The complex residents have access to a 20-meter-long swimming pool that is maintained throughout the year, as well as two furnished relaxation areas. A special advantage of the complex is that the villas have their own swimming pools and garage spaces, while the main pool is used exclusively by the apartment owners, which further contributes to privacy.
The property has complete documentation. A garage parking space is available for an additional fee.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, land lot, 2122m², Podgorica, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je urbanizovan plac površine 2122m² u naselju Gornja Gorica, Podgorica. Plac je idealan za izgradnju porodičnih kuća, vila sa bazenom, kao i vila bez bazena, sa podrumom-garažom, prizemljem, prvim spratom i potkrovljem.
Za grupisane urbanističke parcele postoji mogućnost gradnje većih objekata do tri sprata. Oko placa je izgrađena ulica širine 8,5m sa asfaltom i trotoarima, uključujući fekalnu kanalizaciju, oborinsku kanalizaciju, vodovodnu mrežu sa ostavljenim priključcima za buduće objekte, elektro instalacije, telekomunikacione instalacije i javnu rasvetu.
Plac je odlično povezan sa infrastrukturom i nalazi se u neposrednoj blizini novog naselja "City kvart", tržnih centara "Delta City" i "City Mall", kao i Univerziteta Crne Gore.
Ova lokacija pruža odličnu priliku za razvoj stambenih i komercijalnih objekata. Idealno za investitore koji žele da iskoriste potencijal rasta i razvoja u ovom delu Podgorice.
listing.description_text_en:
For Sale: Urbanized Plot of Land in Gornja Gorica, Podgorica – 2122m²This urbanized plot of land, covering an area of 2122m², is located in the Gornja Gorica neighborhood in Podgorica. The plot is ideal for the construction of family houses, villas with pools, as well as villas without pools, with a basement-garage, ground floor, first floor, and attic.
For grouped urban planning parcels, there is the possibility of building larger buildings up to three floors. The area around the plot has a street built to a width of 8.5m, with asphalt and sidewalks, including sewage, stormwater drainage, a water supply network with connections left for future buildings, electrical installations, telecommunications installations, and street lighting.
The plot is well-connected with infrastructure and is located near the new "City Quarter" neighborhood, "Delta City" and "City Mall" shopping centers, and the University of Montenegro.
This location offers an excellent opportunity for the development of residential and commercial properties. It is ideal for investors looking to take advantage of the growth and development potential in this part of Podgorica.

Predvidjena gradnja P+1(200m2). Nalazi se u blizini nove trafo stanice.(parcela ima teret-lako resivo).
067/231-153

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju rustična vila u Paštrovskom stilu, 2,5 km od Petrovca (Kruševica), u mirnom i izolovanom dijelu. Plac površine 578 m² je popločan kamenom i ima poseban prilaz, garaže za 5 vozila, fitnes salu i bazen od 31 m².
Vila ima ukupno 466 m² stambenog prostora. U prizemlju se nalaze dnevni boravak, kuhinja sa izlazom na dvije terase, dvije spavaće sobe, kupatilo i gostinski toalet. Na spratu su dva fizički odvojena dvosobna stana sa sopstvenim kupatilima i terasama.
Ukupno: 6 spavaćih soba, 5 kupatila, 3 kuhinje, 4 terase. Gradnja započeta 2009, završena 2013. Uknjiženo 1/1, upotrebna dozvola izdata.
067/231-153
listing.description_text_en:
For sale, a rustic villa in Paštrovići style, 2.5 km from Petrovac (Kruševica), in a quiet and isolated part. The land plot with an area of 578 m² is paved with stone and has separate access, garages for 5 vehicles, a fitness room, and a pool of 31 m².
The villa has a total of 466 m² of living space. On the ground floor there are a living room, a kitchen with access to two terraces, two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a guest toilet. On the first floor are two physically separated two-bedroom apartments with their own bathrooms and terraces.
Total: 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 3 kitchens, 4 terraces. Construction started 2009, completed 2013. Registered 1/1, occupancy permit issued.
067/231-153

listing.description_text_en:
In Krašići, municipality of Tivat, on the first line to the sea, there is a land plot of 506 m² with a permit for the construction of a villa of 350 m². The first floor has already been built, and according to the project, a mini-hotel with six apartments is planned, with the possibility of adapting it into a family house.
The property also has a private concrete pier of 160 m². The project is approved, utilities are paid, excavations, a basement and retaining walls have been carried out. Electricity, water and sewerage have been brought to the land plot. The location is quiet, with restaurants and shops within walking distance.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 246m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 223 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 306 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata četiri spavaće sobe, cetiri kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 223 m² with a private plot of 306 m² and a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of space and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. The plot features a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of high-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for rental.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 165m², Donja Gorica, Podgorica
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 165m², Donja Gorica, Podgorica

Apartman u sklopu Verde Village projekta, površine 165,25 m², sa jasno definisanom materijalizacijom. Podne obloge od troslojnog tikovina parketa unose toplinu i sofisticiranost. Kupci imaju priliku da personalizuju enterijer izborom materijala iz ekskluzivnog kataloga.
067/231-153
listing.description_text_en:
Apartment within the Verde Village project, with an area of 165.25 m², with clearly defined materialization. Three-layer teak parquet floor coverings bring warmth and sophistication. Buyers have the opportunity to personalize the interior by choosing materials from an exclusive catalog.
067/231-153

listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 114m², Krašići, Tivat
listing.description_text:
Smešten na poluostrvu Luštica, na obroncima brda, desetak minuta vožnje od Luštica bay kompleksa sa golf terenima ovaj savremeni kompleks moderne arhitekture predstavlja novitet na tržištu nekretnina u Crnoj Gori.
Na prodaju je prostran stan ukupne površine 183 m², koji obuhvata veliki privatni balkon odnosno terasu i zasebnu ostavu.
Stan se odlikuje funkcionalnim rasporedom i svetlim dnevnim boravkom sa dodatnim toaletom, kao i dve spavaće sobe, od kojih svaka ima svoje kupatilo.
Ispred stana nalazi se velika privatna terasa sa prelepim pogledom na more i okolne planine, idealna za opuštanje, obedovanje na otvorenom i uživanje u mediteranskom načinu života.
Stan se isporučuje sa potpuno ugrađenom kuhinjom i integrisanim kuhinjskim uređajima. Kupatila su završena kvalitetnim i modernim materijalima i spremna su za svakodnevnu upotrebu.
U kompleksu su takodje dostupne apartmane s drugim rasporedom.
listing.description_text_en:
Located on the Luštica Peninsula, on the slopes of a hill, a ten-minute drive from the Luštica Bay complex with golf courses, this modern complex of modern architecture is a novelty on the real estate market in Montenegro.
For sale is a spacious apartment with a total area of 183 m², which includes a large private balcony or terrace and a private garden.
The apartment features a functional layout and bright living space with an additional toilet, as well as two bedrooms, each with its own bathroom.
In front of the apartment is a large private terrace with a beautiful view of the sea and the surrounding mountains, ideal for relaxing, al fresco dining and enjoying the Mediterranean way of life.
The apartment is supplied with a fully fitted kitchen and integrated kitchen appliances. The bathrooms are finished with high-quality and modern materials and are ready for everyday use.
The complex also offers apartments with different layouts.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 151m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 151m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se penthouse povrsine 151m2 sa pogledom na more koji je lociran na 10. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok završetka: april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja:Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima i panoramskim pogledom koji spaja najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno je dostupno 66 apartmana za kupovinu, uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmane.
Kompleks poseduje dva ulaza – jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, smešten u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama.
Sadržaji kompleksa:Poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centarDva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko moreSpa centar sa bazenima i teretanomKonferencijski sadržajiPodzemni objekti: tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mestaUsluge i sigurnost:Konsijerž i 24-časovno obezbeđenje garantuju mir i sigurnostRaznovrsna ponuda hotela sa pet zvezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil životaZelena oaza:Ovaj savremeni objekat takođe nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gde ćete moći da uživate u prirodi. Poseban fokus je stavljen na održavanje zelenih površina, koje omogućavaju vlasnicima i gostima sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu.
Pogodnosti:Dva hotelska restorana, kafić, kancelarije i prodavnice na prvim spratovimaSpa centar sa teretanom i bazenimaZelena oaza na krovuBrendirane rezidencijeTehničke prostorije i podzemni parkingBrendirane rezidencije sa uslugom održavanjaPaketi nameštaja dostupni za useljenje
listing.description_text_en:
For sale: Penthouse apartment with an area of 151 m² and sea view, located on the 10th floor of a seafront complex under construction in Budva.
Completion date: April 2028.
Payment plan:Reservation: €10,000 (non-refundable)30% of the purchase price – within 10 days of signing the Preliminary AgreementRemaining amount payable in three installments:First installment 30% – after completion of the structural worksSecond installment 30% – after completion of finishing worksThird installment 10% – upon handover of the propertyThis unique complex is located in the heart of tourist Budva, on the promenade, surrounded by fantastic natural conditions and panoramic views that combine the best of the Budva Riviera with modern buildings, facilities, and 5-star hotel services.
Residential units available for sale are located from the fourth to the ninth floor. These carefully designed apartments provide a perfect combination of luxury and functionality, with stunning views of the surroundings. The tenth floor is exclusively dedicated to penthouse apartments, boasting luxurious features such as hot tubs and spacious terraces. In total, 66 apartments are available for purchase, including rooms, apartments, and penthouses.
The complex has two entrances – one conveniently located on the promenade and the other accessible from the boulevard. The main entrance, situated in the annex of the congress center, allows easy access to various events and conferences.
Complex facilities:Commercial space, shops, and service centerTwo restaurants and a café overlooking the Adriatic SeaSpa center with pools and gymConference facilitiesUnderground premises: technical rooms and underground parking with 160 spacesServices and security:Concierge and 24-hour security ensure peace and safetyA wide range of 5-star hotel services and Budva’s amenities turn your investment into a luxurious lifestyleGreen oasis:This modern building also offers a green oasis on the roof of the congress hall, where you can enjoy nature. Special focus is placed on maintaining green areas, allowing owners and guests to enjoy nature and local flora year-round right at their doorstep.
Advantages:Two hotel restaurants, café, offices, and shops on the first floorsSpa center with pools and gymGreen oasis on the roofBranded residencesTechnical premises and underground parkingBranded residences with maintenance serviceFurniture packages available for move-in

listing.description_text:
Na elitnoj lokaciji u srcu Bokokotorskog zaliva, svega 13 km od Porto Montenegra i 15 minuta od aerodroma Tivat, nalazi se luksuzna vila u okviru premium kompleksa THE CUBE.
• Površina vile: 350 m² • Terasa: 36 m² • Plac: 915 m²
Vila se prostire na dve etaže – donji nivo sadrži prostran dnevni boravak i dve spavaće sobe, dok se na spratu nalaze još tri sobe, idealne za veću porodicu ili goste.
Velike panoramske staklene površine pružaju spektakularan pogled na more i okolne planine.
Dodatne pogodnosti:
• Privatni bazen • Garaža • Prostrano dvorište za odmor i druženje
Spoj komfora, elegancije i mediteranskog načina života – savršeno mesto za dom iz snova.
listing.description_text_en:
In an elite location in the heart of Bokokotorskog zaliva, only 13 km from Porto Montenegro and 15 minutes from Tivat airport, there is a luxury villa.
• Villa area: 350 m² • Terrace: 36 m² • Land plot: 915 m²
The villa extends over two floors – the lower level contains a spacious living room and two bedrooms, while on the upper floor there are three more rooms, ideal for a larger family or guests.
Large panoramic glass surfaces provide a spectacular view of the sea and surrounding mountains.
Additional amenities:
• Private pool • Garage • Spacious courtyard for relaxation and socializing
A combination of comfort, elegance, and Mediterranean lifestyle – a perfect place for a dream home.

Na prodaju luksuzan jednosoban stan površine 99 m², smešten u prizemlju prestižnog kompleksa Dukley Gardens, u neposrednoj blizini mora – Seaside Line / prva linija.

For sale is a luxurious one-bedroom apartment with an area of 99 m², located on the ground floor of the prestigious Dukley Gardens complex, in the immediate vicinity of the sea – Seaside Line / first line.
The apartment consists of:
Spacious living room with kitchen and dining area
Elegant bedroom
Modern bathroom
Terrace with direct access to greenery and sea view
Features:
Highest quality materials and modern design
Privacy, security, and peace in a closed complex
Direct access to the coast and promenade
Return on Investment (ROI): 6% annually
A perfect combination of luxury, location, and stable investment on the Montenegrin coast.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 58m², Bečići, Budva
listing.description_text:
Prodaja jednosobnog stana 58 m² sa pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu u Rafailovićima – prvi red do mora sa privatnom plažom i luksuznim sadržajimaPredstavljamo vam jedinstvenu priliku za kupovinu luksuznog stana direktno na bečićkoj plaži. Smješten na prvoj liniji mora, samo 10 metara od čuvene plaže koja važi za jednu od najlepših na Jadranu, ovaj moderan stambeni kompleks u izgradnji kombinuje vrhunski dizajn, ekskluzivne sadržaje i privatnu plažu, nudeći nezaboravno iskustvo života na moru. Stanari imaju ekskluzivan privatni pristup plaži ispred objekta, a u blizini se nalaze restorani, kafići, barovi i butici koji čine život praktičnim i zabavnim.
Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.
listing.description_text_en:
Sale of a One-Bedroom Apartment 58 m² with Sea View in an Exclusive Residential Complex in Rafailovići – First Line to the Sea with Private Beach and Luxury AmenitiesWe present a unique opportunity to purchase a luxury apartment directly on Bečići Beach. Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 meters from the famous beach considered one of the most beautiful on the Adriatic, this modern residential complex under construction combines top-quality design, exclusive amenities, and a private beach, offering an unforgettable seaside living experience. Residents have exclusive private access to the beach in front of the building, while nearby restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques make life convenient and enjoyable.
The complex offers luxury facilities for relaxation and entertainment, including indoor and outdoor pools with panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea, a fully equipped modern fitness center, a two-level casino, a fully equipped wellness and spa center, and retail spaces with restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques.
The project features a 12-story residential building with a total of 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, designed to meet the highest standards of comfort, privacy, and luxurious coastal living. All apartments come fully furnished, with double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation, using only the highest quality materials to ensure durability and comfort.
Apartments come in various layouts and sizes: studios of 38 m², one-bedroom apartments of 53–69 m², two-bedroom apartments of 84–113 m², and three-bedroom apartments of 161–170 m². Prices range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, defining a price per square meter of €4,700 to €8,500 depending on the type, floor, and layout. Monthly maintenance fee is €6.90/m².
The attractive payment plan includes 10% upon reservation, 60% during construction with completion in December 2026, and the remaining 30% in May 2027, with handover planned for March–April 2027. Grand Opening is scheduled for summer 2027.
Additionally, there is an attractive profit-sharing model with professional management and high expected occupancy – 70% to the owner and 30% to management, making this property ideal for both living and investment.
This is a unique opportunity for luxury living or investment on the most beautiful beach of the Budva Riviera, with exclusive amenities, a private beach, and panoramic sea views.

Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 113m², Bečići, Budva
listing.description_text:
Prodaja dvosobnog stana 113 m² u ekskluzivnom modernom stambenom kompleksu u Rafailovicima – prvi red do mora sa privatnom plažom i luksuznim sadržajimaPredstavljamo vam jedinstvenu priliku za kupovinu luksuznog stana direktno na bečićkoj plaži. Smješten na prvoj liniji mora, samo 10 metara od čuvene plaže koja važi za jednu od najlepših na Jadranu, ovaj moderan stambeni kompleks u izgradnji kombinuje vrhunski dizajn, ekskluzivne sadržaje i privatnu plažu, nudeći nezaboravno iskustvo života na moru. Stanari imaju ekskluzivan privatni pristup plaži ispred objekta, a u blizini se nalaze restorani, kafići, barovi i butici koji čine život praktičnim i zabavnim.
Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.

This apartment represents an excellent choice for family living, but also as an investment for rental during the tourist season. A parking space is also included with the apartment.

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 265 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje.
Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.
listing.description_text_en:
A luxury townhouse villa of 220 m² with a private plot of 265 m² and a swimming pool is up for sale. It is located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a memorable view of the Adriatic Sea.
There is a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard on the plot, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property has special advantages — the option of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica.
Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa is a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

Prodaje se prazan, što omogućava kupcu da ga opremi po svom ukusu. Ima pogled na rijeku. Ima parking ispred zgrade a postoji mogućnost i kupovine podzemne garaže.• Mogućnost kupovine garažnog mjesta: 20.000 €, Lux

listing.title_text: Prodaja, četvorosoban stan, 220m², Preko Morače, Podgorica
listing.title_text_en: Sale, four bedroom apartment, 220m², Preko Morače, Podgorica
listing.description_text:
Podgorica, preko Morače – ekskluzivan duplex stan
Na prodaju izuzetno komforan duplex stan ukupne površine 220 m² (200 m² upisano), smješten na jednoj od najprestižnijih lokacija u dijelu grada preko Morače, u zgradi Glorije.
Stan je organizovan na dvije etaže i pruža odličan balans prostora i funkcionalnosti. Donji nivo čine prostrani dnevni boravak sa izlazom na terasu, odvojena kuhinja, dvije spavaće sobe, kupatilo, gostinski toalet, ostava i dvije terase. Exclusive villa with an area of 275 m², located on a land plot of 450 m², in an attractive location in Budva, in the zone of Jadranskog puta. This property represents a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and functionality, ideal for living or investment on the Montenegrin coast.
The villa features three spacious bedrooms and four modernly equipped bathrooms, providing a high level of comfort and privacy. The carefully designed room layout allows for maximum utilization of space and an abundance of natural light.

listing.description_text:
NA PRODAJU ILI ZAMJENA – PORODIČNO IMANJE U VALJEVSKOJ LOZNICI, NADOMAK VALJEVA
Na prodaju prostrano porodično imanje smješteno u mirnom i prirodnom ambijentu Valjevske Loznice, na svega nekoliko minuta od Valjeva.
Imanje se prostire na 3 hektara (30.000 m²) i obuhvata plodnu zemlju, šumu, podignute šljivike, stambeni objekat površine 180 m², kao i dodatnih 100 m² pomoćnih objekata, uključujući pečenjaru.
Kuća raspolaže sa 4 spavaće sobe, kupatilom i parkingom za četiri vozila.
Imanje izlazi na seosku rječicu i posjeduje sopstveni bunar, a dostupni su i gradski vodovod, javna rasvjeta i dobra putna povezanost.
Lokacija je udaljena svega nekoliko minuta od magistralnog puta i lokalne pruge, 7–8 minuta vožnje od centra Valjeva, a oko 30 minuta od Beograda. U blizini se nalaze i banja Vrujci i druge atraktivne turističke lokacije.
Mirno okruženje, priroda i velika površina zemljišta pružaju odlične mogućnosti za porodični život, odmor, poljoprivredu, voćarstvo ili razvoj seoskog turizma.
Moguća zamjena za nekretninu na crnogorskom primorju, uz dogovor.
listing.description_text_en:
FOR SALE OR EXCHANGE – FAMILY ESTATE IN VALJEVSKA LOZNICA, NEAR VALJEVO
For sale, a spacious family estate located in the peaceful and natural environment of Valjevska Loznica, just a few minutes from Valjevo.
The estate spans 3 hectares (30,000 m²) and includes fertile land, forest, established plum orchards, a residential building with an area of 180 m², as well as an additional 100 m² of ancillary buildings, including a BBQ house.
The house features 4 bedrooms, a bathroom, and parking for four vehicles.
The estate borders a village river and has its own well, and city water supply, public lighting, and good road connections are available.
The location is just a few minutes from the main road and local railway, 7–8 minutes drive from the center of Valjevo, and about 30 minutes from Belgrade. Nearby are also Banja Vrujci and other attractive tourist locations.
The peaceful environment, nature, and large land area provide excellent opportunities for family life, vacation, agriculture, fruit farming, or the development of rural tourism.
Possible exchange for a property on the Montenegrin coast, by agreement.

Prodaja zemljišta sa projektom hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Zemljište se nalazi na crnogorskom poluostrvu Luštica, u najvećem zalivu na Jadranskom moru - na obali Boko Kotorskog zaliva, koji se naziva najjužnijim fjordom u Evropi, 10 minuta od tivatskog aerodroma.
Poslednji plac na samoj obali mora gde je još uvek moguće izgraditi hotel sa 5 zvezdica. Priroda ovde je luksuzna. Veličanstvene planine, azurno more. Usamljene uvale sa sitnim peščanim i šljunčanim plažama su raštrkane duž obale, a u okolini se nalaze borovi i maslinjaci, autentična sela, privatna imanja i vinogradi. Jednom rečju, idila.
Postavljeni su temelji za izgradnju područja Golf Residences. Svetski poznati igrač Geri Plejer je pozvan da razvije projekat golf terena. Ovde će biti izgrađen profesionalni teren sa 18 rupa, prvih 9 će biti otvoreno do kraja 2023. godine. Generalno, projekat je jedinstveni. Prema rečima stručnjaka, manje od 10% golf terena u svetu pruža mogućnost posmatranja mora sa bilo koje tačke.
Naselje Centrale će postati trgovački, administrativni i kulturni centar.
Tu će biti smeštene glavne gradske službe: obdanište, škola i zdravstveni centar, policijska i vatrogasna stanica, banka, pošta, autoservis i benzinska pumpa, autlet selo, konferencijski centar i sportski kompleksi. U naselju će biti uređeni novi parkovi, uređena šetališta, otvorene galerije, prodavnice i kafići na centralnom trgu.
Cena zemljišta je 9 447 750 e

Ukupna površina nadzemnih etaža 8 382,34 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 5.956,10 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 14.338,44 m2
KUĆA ZA GOSTE:

listing.description_text_en:
Sale of a land plot with a 5-star hotel project.
The land plot is located on the Montenegrin peninsula Luštica, in the largest bay on the Adriatic Sea - on the coast of Boko Kotorskog zaliva, which is called the southernmost fjord in Europe, 10 minutes from Tivat airport.
The last land plot directly on the seashore where it is still possible to build a 5-star hotel. The nature here is luxurious. Magnificent mountains, azure sea. Secluded coves with fine sandy and pebble beaches are scattered along the coast, and in the surroundings there are pine and olive groves, authentic villages, private estates and vineyards. In a word, an idyll.
Foundations have been laid for the construction of the Golf Residences area. World-renowned player Geri Plejer has been invited to develop the golf course project. Here, an 18-hole professional course will be built, the first 9 will be open by the end of 2023. Generally, the project is unique. According to experts, less than 10% of golf courses in the world offer the possibility of observing the sea from any point.
The Centrale settlement will become a commercial, administrative, and cultural center.
The main city services will be located there: kindergarten, school, and health center, police and fire station, bank, post office, car service, and gas station, outlet village, conference center, and sports complexes. New parks will be arranged in the settlement, arranged promenades, open galleries, shops, and cafes on the central square.
The price of the land plot is 9 447 750 e
Area of the land plot 20 995 m2
Total area of the complex - 16 287 m2

O rezidenciji
Ovaj moderan stambeni projekat nalazi se u naselju Dubovica Lux u Budvi, na odličnoj lokaciji u blizini autobuske stanice, fakulteta i novog Mega Malla na Zaobilaznici. Udaljen je oko 7 minuta hoda od glavne autobuske stanice, 15 minuta od centra grada i oko 15 minuta od plaže.
Kompleks se sastoji od 39 stanova različitih struktura (studio, jednosobni, dvosobni i trosobni apartmani) i 40 garažnih mjesta. Stanarima su na raspolaganju recepcija i 24/7 obezbjeđenje, spa centar sa teretanom, saunom i jacuzzi-jem, spoljni grijani bazen, pool bar, restoran, dječije igralište, šatl prevoz do plaže i avantura park u neposrednoj blizini. Svi stanovi imaju pogled na more.
Objekat je projektovan u klasičnom stilu, južne orijentacije, sa velikim staklenim površinama koje obezbjeđuju puno prirodnog svjetla. U gradnji se koriste visokokvalitetni evropski ekološki materijali.
Stanovi se prodaju sa uključenim dizajnerskim enterijerom i kompletnim završnim radovima: spušteni plafoni, rasvjeta, dekorativni kamen, granit ili parket, opremljena kupatila sa italijanskom sanitarnom opremom, podno grijanje, smart sistem, aluminijumska stolarija i fasada od prirodnog kamena.
Planirani završetak radova je oktobar 2027. godine.

About the residence
This modern residential project is located in the Dubovica Lux neighborhood in Budva, in an excellent location near the bus station, university, and the new Mega Mall on Zaobilaznica. It is about a 7-minute walk from the main bus station, 15 minutes from the city center, and about 15 minutes from the beach.
The complex consists of 39 apartments of various structures (studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments) and 40 parking spaces. Residents have access to reception and 24/7 security, a spa center with a gym, sauna, and jacuzzi, an outdoor heated pool, a pool bar, a restaurant, a children's playground, shuttle transport to the beach, and an adventure park in the immediate vicinity. All apartments have a sea view.
The building is designed in a classic style, south-facing, with large glass surfaces that provide plenty of natural light. High-quality European ecological materials are used in construction.
The apartments are sold with included designer interior and complete finishing works: suspended ceilings, lighting, decorative stone, granite or parquet, equipped bathrooms with Italian sanitary ware, underfloor heating, smart system, aluminum joinery, and a natural stone facade.
The planned completion of works is October 2027.

Stan ima površinu od 282m², uz dodatak krovne terase od 235m², idealne za uživanje u panoramskim pogledima i opuštanje na otvorenom.
Ova nekretnina je kompletno završena i useljiva, pružajući vam mogućnost da se odmah uselite i uživate u svim pogodnostima koje nudi.
Postoji mogućnost kupovine ove nekretnine u kriptovaluti Bitcoin, čime se omogućava fleksibilnost u plaćanju.
Dukley Gardens je elitna nekretnina na jadranskoj obali u najslikovitijem mestu Crne Gore. Otkrijte Crnu Goru, zemlju ogromnih prirodnih bogatstava i najčistijeg mora, prirodnih ukusa i pažljivo očuvanih drevnih tradicija. Svaki dan, svaki minut će biti ispunjen harmonijom i lepotom. Od sjajnog izlaska sunca do romantičnog zalaska sunca, čekaju vas nezaboravni utisci koje ćete želeti da iskusite iznova i iznova. Dopustite sebi da se opustite u prostranom i udobnom domu, opustite se na plaži skrivenoj od radoznalih očiju, uživajte u gastronomskoj večeri na ogromnoj terasi sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadran.
Osmišljen od strane međunarodne grupe uglednih projektanata, renomiranih graditelja i nagrađivanih arhitekata, u saradnji sa vrhunskim kreativnim timom konsultanata za dizajn i tehnologiju, Dukley nudi izvanredne sadržaje i usluge. Sa pogledom na jednu od najlepših obala na svetu, ovaj kompleks ekskluzivnih rezidencijalnih vila spaja najmoderniju infrastrukturu, sofisticirani savremeni dizajn i vrhunske sadržaje, podižući ljestvicu kvaliteta primorskih rezidencijalnih kompleksa u Crnoj Gori.
Uz pomoć najsavremenije Smart Home tehnologije koja osigurava kompletnu bezbednost, stanari kompleksa Dukley Gardens mogu kontrolisati svoje stanove koristeći lične uređaje. Putem telefona ili tableta svaki stanar može upravljati osvetljenjem i klima uređajima, kao i multimedija sistemima i sistemima za bezbednost i nadzor u svom stanu.

listing.description_text_en:
Real Estate, MontenegroFor sale is a luxurious three-bedroom penthouse apartment with a spectacular direct sea view, located in the prestigious Dukley Gardens complex, Budva.
The apartment has an area of 2282m², along with a 235m² rooftop terrace, perfect for enjoying panoramic views and relaxing outdoors.
This property is fully finished and ready to move in, offering you the opportunity to settle in immediately and enjoy all the amenities it offers.
There is an option to purchase this property using the cryptocurrency Bitcoin, providing flexibility in payment.
Dukley Gardens is an elite property on the Adriatic coast in the most picturesque place in Montenegro. Discover Montenegro, a land of vast natural wealth and the cleanest sea, natural flavors, and carefully preserved ancient traditions. Every day, every moment will be filled with harmony and beauty. From the brilliant sunrise to the romantic sunset, unforgettable impressions await you that you will want to experience again and again. Allow yourself to relax in a spacious and comfortable home, unwind on a beach hidden from prying eyes, and enjoy a gourmet dinner on a large terrace with a panoramic view of the Adriatic.
Designed by an international group of renowned designers, builders, and award-winning architects, in collaboration with a top creative team of design and technology consultants, Dukley offers exceptional amenities and services. With a view of one of the most beautiful coastlines in the world, this complex of exclusive residential villas combines the most modern infrastructure, sophisticated contemporary design, and premium amenities, raising the bar for the quality of coastal residential complexes in Montenegro.
With the help of the most advanced Smart Home technology ensuring complete security, Dukley Gardens residents can control their apartments using personal devices. Via phone or tablet, each resident can manage lighting and climate control, as well as multimedia systems and security and surveillance systems in their apartment.

listing.description_text:
Smještena u mirnoj i prestižnoj rezidencijalnoj zoni Gornje Gorice, predstavlja spoj moderne arhitekture, vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i sofisticiranog načina života. Ova ekskluzivna vila površine 231 m² projektovana je sa posebnim fokusom na funkcionalnost, privatnost i dugoročnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Prostran i svijetao enterijer karakterišu otvoreni koncept dnevnog boravka, velike staklene površine i obilje prirodnog svjetla tokom cijelog dana, stvarajući prijatan i elegantan ambijent za svakodnevni život.
Vila posjeduje privatnu wellness zonu koja uključuje grijani bazen sa masažnim mlazovima i luksuznu finsku KYRA saunu, pružajući potpuni osjećaj relaksacije i odmora u udobnosti sopstvenog doma.
Objekat je opremljen naprednim Smart Home sistemom koji omogućava jednostavno upravljanje rasvjetom, grijanjem, hlađenjem, sigurnosnim sistemima i ostalim funkcijama putem mobilnog telefona. Dodatni nivo sigurnosti obezbijeđen je HD video nadzorom, alarmnim sistemom, kontrolom pristupa i perimetarskom zaštitom.
Energetska efikasnost vile postignuta je savremenim sistemima kao što su podno grijanje sa toplotnom pumpom, multi-split i kanalni klima sistemi bez vidljivih unutrašnjih jedinica, kao i unaprijed pripremljena infrastruktura za solarne panele, što omogućava niže troškove energije i održiv način života.
U izgradnji i opremanju korišćeni su premium materijali i renomirani svjetski brendovi poput Porcelanosa keramike, Tarkett parketa, Hansgrohe AXOR i Geberit sanitarnih sistema, Villeroy & Boch opreme, Florim keramike i aluminijumske stolarije, garantujući vrhunsku estetiku, dugotrajnost i visoku tržišnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Lokacija vile pruža idealan balans između privatnosti i urbanog života.
listing.description_text_en:
Located in the quiet and prestigious residential zone of Gornja Gorica, it represents a blend of modern architecture, premium construction quality, and a sophisticated lifestyle. This exclusive villa with an area of 231 m² is designed with a special focus on functionality, privacy, and long-term property value.
The spacious and bright interior is characterized by an open-concept living room, large glass surfaces, and an abundance of natural light throughout the day, creating a pleasant and elegant ambiance for everyday life.
The villa has a private wellness zone which includes a heated pool with massage jets and a luxurious Finnish KYRA sauna, providing a complete sense of relaxation and rest in the comfort of your own home.
The property is equipped with an advanced Smart Home system which allows for easy control of lighting, heating, cooling, security systems, and other functions via mobile phone. An additional level of security is provided by HD video surveillance, an alarm system, access control, and perimeter protection.
The energy efficiency of the villa is achieved through modern systems such as underfloor heating with a heat pump, multi-split and ducted air conditioning systems without visible indoor units, as well as pre-prepared infrastructure for solar panels, which enables lower energy costs and a sustainable lifestyle.
Premium materials and renowned global brands were used in the construction and furnishing such as Porcelanosa ceramics, Tarkett parquet, Hansgrohe AXOR and Geberit sanitary systems, Villeroy & Boch equipment, Florim ceramics, and aluminum joinery, guaranteeing superior aesthetics, durability, and high market value of the property.
The villa's location provides an ideal balance between privacy and urban life.

An exclusive luxurious villa with an area of 400m² is for lease, located in one of the most prestigious and most sought-after parts of Podgorica – Gorica C.
The villa is located in a peaceful, green, and elite environment, in the immediate vicinity of embassies and residential buildings, which makes it an ideal choice for embassies, representative offices, companies, residential purposes, or a luxurious family life.

Rezidencijalni kompleks sa pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv
Smješten u Herceg Novom, u neposrednoj blizini prestižnog Portonovi rizorta i svega oko 200 metara od mora, ovaj savremeni rezidencijalni kompleks predstavlja atraktivnu priliku za život, odmor i investiranje.
Kompleks obuhvata 56 stambenih jedinica, sa jednosobnim (1+1) i dvosobnim (2+1) stanovima. Zahvaljujući atraktivnoj lokaciji i okolnoj izgradnji, stanovi nude otvoren pogled prema moru i Bokokotorskom zalivu.
Stanovi 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Cijena: 350.000 – 430.100 € Cijena zavisi od spratnosti i pozicije.
Sadržaji kompleksa
Stanovnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su brojni sadržaji:
• otvoreni i zatvoreni bazen
• moderna teretana
• tursko kupatilo i sauna
• prostor za odmor i kafić
• dječije igralište
• recepcija i obezbjeđenje
• otvoreni parking i podzemna garaža
• lift za automobile
• stanica za punjenje električnih vozila
• rezervni generator za kontinuirano snabdijevanje električnom energijom
Investiciona vrijednost
Kompleks je pogodan za kratkoročno i dugoročno izdavanje, kao i za privatno korišćenje. Kupcima koji nekretninu kupuju kao investiciju biće pružena podrška u procesu izdavanja i upravljanja rentiranjem.
Lokacija u neposrednoj blizini Portonovi rizorta, luksuznih vila, marine i hotela dodatno povećava atraktivnost nekretnine. Hotel One&Only nalazi se na približno 150 metara, dok je plaža udaljena oko 400 metara. U okolini se nalaze restorani, prodavnice, škole, parkovi i drugi sadržaji.
Finansiranje i plan plaćanja
Predviđen je fleksibilan model kupovine:
• 50% početnog učešća
• 50% kroz mjesečne ili kvartalne rate do 24 mjeseca
• dinamika plaćanja se može uskladiti sa individualnim dogovorom i fazom izgradnje
Dostupna je i mogućnost kreditnog finansiranja do 30% vrijednosti nekretnine putem partnerskih banaka Erste i Ziraat, uz planirano proširenje saradnje sa Adriatic bankom.
Šta je uključeno u cijenu
U cijenu stana uključeni su PDV i kuhinjski namještaj. Kuhinjski aparati nijesu uključeni.
Troškovi prenosa vlasništva, notarske i druge administrativne takse nijesu uključeni.
Parking se prodaje posebno:
• Otvoreno parking mjesto: 10.000 €
• Podzemno garažno mjesto: 30.000 €
Ova nekretnina predstavlja spoj luksuzne lokacije, savremenih sadržaja, pogleda na more i investicionog potencijala, pogodnog kako za vlastito korišćenje, tako i za prihod od izdavanja.
listing.description_text_en:
Residential complex with a view of Bokokotorski zaliv
Located in Herceg Novom, in the immediate vicinity of the prestigious Portonovi resort and only about 200 meters from the sea, this modern residential complex represents an attractive opportunity for living, vacation, and investment.
The complex includes 56 residential units, with one-bedroom (1+1) and two-bedroom (2+1) apartments. Thanks to the attractive location and surrounding construction, the apartments offer an open view towards the sea and Bokokotorski zaliv.
Apartments 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Price: 350.000 – 430.100 € The price depends on the floor and position.
Complex amenities
Numerous amenities are available to residents and guests:
• outdoor and indoor pool
• modern gym
• Turkish bath and sauna
• relaxation area and cafe
• children's playground
• reception and security
• outdoor parking and underground garage
• car elevator
• electric vehicle charging station
• backup generator for continuous electricity supply
Investment value
The complex is suitable for short-term and long-term rental, as well as for private use. Buyers who purchase the property as an investment will be provided with support in the process of renting out and rental management.
The location in the immediate vicinity of Portonovi resort, luxury villas, marina, and hotels further increases the attractiveness of the property. Hotel One&Only is located approximately 150 meters away, while the beach is about 400 meters away. In the surroundings, there are restaurants, shops, schools, parks, and other amenities.
Financing and payment plan
A flexible purchase model is foreseen:
• 50% initial down payment
• 50% through monthly or quarterly installments up to 24 months
• payment dynamics can be aligned with individual agreement and the construction phase
The possibility of loan financing up to 30% of the property value through partner banks Erste and Ziraat, with a planned expansion of cooperation with Adriatic bank, is also available.
What is included in the price
The apartment price includes VAT and kitchen furniture. Kitchen appliances are not included.
Costs of ownership transfer, notary, and other administrative fees are not included.
Parking is sold separately:
• Outdoor parking space: 10.000 €
• Underground garage space: 30.000 €
This property represents a combination of luxury location, modern amenities, sea views, and investment potential, suitable for both private use and rental income.

listing.description_text:
EKSKLUZIVNI TOWNHOUSE PROJEKAT
Predstavljamo vam ekskluzivan kompleks od 9 luksuznih townhouse vila, projektovanih za savršen spoj modernog dizajna, komfora, privatnosti i prirodnog okruženja.
Smešten na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, kompleks pruža panoramski pogled na Jadransko more, planine i Sveti Stefan. Mirna lokacija, visok standard gradnje i odlična povezanost sa najpoznatijim destinacijama čine ovaj projekat idealnim za luksuzno stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju sa potencijalom za profitabilno izdavanje.
ISTAKNUTA JEDINICA – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
Kompleks je organizovan u tri objekta – A, B i C – sa po tri townhouse jedinice, ukupno 9 ekskluzivnih vila. Svaka vila prostire se na četiri nivoa i pažljivo je osmišljena kako bi pružila maksimalnu funkcionalnost, privatnost i uživanje u panoramskom pogledu.
Glavne karakteristike vila:
• 4 prostrane spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• 2 dnevne zone
• 2 potpuno opremljene kuhinje
• privatni bazen
• prostrane terase sa pogledom na more
• garaža za 2 automobila
• visoki plafoni od 3 m
• panoramski prozori visine 2,5 m
• video nadzor i interfon
• multi-split klima sistem
• optički internet
• sistem zaštite od požara
• centralno zagrevanje vode
• rezervni tehnički sistemi
VRHUNSKI STANDARDI GRADNJE
Arhitektura vila kombinuje savremenu estetiku sa prirodnim i kvalitetnim materijalima. Eksterijer karakteriše prirodni kamen, dok energetski efikasna aluminijumska stolarija i velike staklene površine obezbeđuju obilje prirodnog svetla i neometan pogled prema moru.
Enterijer je opremljen pažljivo odabranim materijalima visokog kvaliteta, uključujući hrastov parket u spavaćim sobama, vrhunsku keramiku i sanitarije renomiranog brenda Villeroy & Boch. Svaka vila poseduje kompletan smart tehnički i sigurnosni sistem.
PRIVATNI BAZEN
Privatni bazen predstavlja idealno mesto za opuštanje i uživanje tokom toplih letnjih dana. Opremljen je kompletnim sistemom za filtraciju, osvetljenje i održavanje, pružajući vlasnicima visok nivo komfora i privatnosti.
ATRAKTIVNA LOKACIJA
Projekat se nalazi u mirnom i privatnom okruženju, a istovremeno je odlično povezan sa najvažnijim destinacijama crnogorskog primorja:
• 5 minuta do Svetog Stefana
• 10 minuta do Budve
• 30 minuta do Porto Montenegra i Kotora
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Tivat
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Podgorica
USLOVI PLAĆANJA
• 5.000 € – rezervacija
• 10% – pri potpisu ugovora
• 30% – nakon završetka grubih radova
• 30% – nakon završetka finih radova
• 30% – po dobijanju upotrebne dozvole, umanjeno za iznos rezervacije
Ovaj projekat predstavlja izuzetnu priliku za kupce koji žele luksuznu rezidenciju na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investitore zainteresovane za visokoprofitabilno turističko izdavanje.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – spoj savremenog luksuza, privatnosti i jedinstvenog pogleda na Jadran.
listing.description_text_en:
EXCLUSIVE TOWNHOUSE PROJECT
We present an exclusive complex of 9 luxury townhouse villas, designed for a perfect blend of modern design, comfort, privacy, and natural surroundings.
Located in one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast, the complex offers panoramic views of Jadransko more, mountains, and Sveti Stefan. A quiet location, high construction standards, and excellent connectivity to the most famous destinations make this project ideal for luxury living, vacation, or investment with potential for profitable rental.
FEATURED UNIT – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
The complex is organized into three buildings – A, B, and C – each with three townhouse units, totaling 9 exclusive villas. Each villa spans four levels and is carefully designed to provide maximum functionality, privacy, and enjoyment of the panoramic view.
Main characteristics of the villas:
• 4 spacious bedrooms with private bathrooms
• 2 living areas
• 2 fully equipped kitchens
• private pool
• spacious terraces with sea views
• garage for 2 cars
• high ceilings of 3 m
• panoramic windows 2.5 m high
• video surveillance and intercom
• multi-split air conditioning system
• fiber optic internet
• fire protection system
• central water heating
• backup technical systems
PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION STANDARDS
The architecture of the villas combines contemporary aesthetics with natural and quality materials. The exterior features natural stone, while energy-efficient aluminum joinery and large glass surfaces ensure abundant natural light and unobstructed sea views.
The interior is equipped with carefully selected high-quality materials, including oak parquet in the bedrooms, premium ceramics, and sanitary ware from the renowned brand Villeroy & Boch. Each villa features a complete smart technical and security system.
PRIVATE POOL
The private pool is an ideal place for relaxation and enjoyment during warm summer days. It is equipped with a complete system for filtration, lighting, and maintenance, providing owners with a high level of comfort and privacy.
ATTRACTIVE LOCATION
The project is located in a quiet and private environment, while also being well-connected to the most important destinations of the Montenegrin coast:
• 5 minutes to Sveti Stefan
• 10 minutes to Budva
• 30 minutes to Porto Montenegro and Kotor
• about 50 minutes to Tivat airport
• about 50 minutes to Podgorica airport
PAYMENT TERMS
• 5,000 € – reservation
• 10% – upon signing the contract
• 30% – after completion of rough works
• 30% – after completion of fine works
• 30% – upon obtaining the occupancy permit, reduced by the reservation amount
This project represents an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a luxury residence on the Montenegrin coast, as well as for investors interested in high-profit tourist rentals.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – a blend of contemporary luxury, privacy, and unique views of the Adriatic.

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 154 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 220 m² and a private plot of 154 m² with a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and abundance of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a private pool on the plot, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive the right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 46m², Radanovići, Kotor
listing.description_text:
Moderan stambeni kompleks u Radanovićima – spoj komfora, prirode i odlične lokacije
Na atraktivnoj lokaciji u Radanovićima, između Tivta, Kotora i Budve, gradi se moderan stambeni kompleks koji pruža idealne uslove za stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju.
Kompleks obuhvata 5 stambenih lamela sa ukupno 72 stana, različitih struktura – garsonjere, jednosobne i dvosobne stanove. Pažljivo osmišljeni rasporedi, savremeni enterijeri, prostrane terase i funkcionalni prostori pružaju udobnost i kvalitet svakodnevnog života.
Sadržaji i pogodnosti:
• Grijani poluolimpijski bazen
• Uređene zelene površine i botanički vrt
• Dječje igralište i prostor za rekreaciju
• Savremena arhitektura i elegantan dizajn enterijera
• Kuhinja sa ugradnim elementima
• Klima uređaji i Smart Home sistem
• Otvoreni parking
• Garažno mjesto po cijeni od 10.000 €
Pojedini stanovi u prizemlju imaju pristup privatnim zelenim površinama, dok stanovi na višim spratovima nude prostrane terase.
Fleksibilni uslovi plaćanja:
• 40% učešća prilikom kupovine
• Preostalih 60% kroz 24 mjesečne rate bez kamate
• 5% popusta za jednokratno plaćanje cjelokupnog iznosa
Mirno okruženje, uređeno dvorište i blizina svih važnih sadržaja čine ovaj kompleks odličnim izborom za porodični život, odmor na primorju ili dugoročnu investiciju.
Planirani završetak radova: april 2027. godine.
listing.description_text_en:
Modern residential complex in Radanovići – a combination of comfort, nature, and an excellent location
In an attractive location in Radanovići, between Tivat, Kotor, and Budva, a modern residential complex is being built, providing ideal conditions for living, vacation, or investment.
The complex includes 5 residential buildings with a total of 72 apartments, of various structures – studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. Carefully designed layouts, modern interiors, spacious terraces, and functional spaces provide comfort and quality for everyday living.
Amenities and advantages:
• Heated semi-Olympic pool
• Landscaped green areas and botanical garden
• Children's playground and recreation area
• Modern architecture and elegant interior design
• Kitchen with built-in elements
• Air conditioning units and Smart Home system
• Open parking
• Garage space at a price of 10.000 €
Some apartments on the ground floor have access to private green areas, while apartments on higher floors offer spacious terraces.
Flexible payment terms:
• 40% down payment upon purchase
• Remaining 60% in 24 monthly installments without interest
• 5% discount for one-time payment of the full amount
Peaceful surroundings, a landscaped courtyard, and proximity to all important amenities make this complex an excellent choice for family life, vacation on the coast, or a long-term investment.
Planned completion of works: April 2027.
