listing.title_text_en: Sale, studio apartment, 54m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description_text:
Luksuzni studio apartman sa terasom – 298.100 €
Ekskluzivni studio apartman smješten je na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, između Budve i Svetog Stefana, u okruženju mediteranskog rastinja, maslinjaka i parka Miločer. U okviru privatnog kompleksa površine 10.000 m², ova nekretnina pruža spoj udobnosti, privatnosti i savremenog luksuza.
Apartman raspolaže unutrašnjom površinom od 46,4 m², uz dodatnu terasu od 7,8 m², što čini ukupnu površinu od 54,2 m². Funkcionalan raspored omogućava optimalno korišćenje prostora, dok se mediteranski stil enterijera, prirodni materijali i pažljivo odabrani detalji uklapaju u ambijent luksuznog odmora.
Nekretnina se nalazi u kompleksu koji objedinjuje hotelske usluge sa pet zvjezdica i sadržaje namijenjene opuštanju. Vlasnicima su na raspolaganju spa zona, panoramski bazen sa barom i pogledom na more, uređeni park, organizovan transfer do plaže, kao i usluge konsijerža i obezbjeđenja dostupne 24/7.
Apartman predstavlja zanimljivu opciju za lični boravak na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investiciju uz mogućnost turističkog izdavanja, u skladu sa uslovima upravljanja.
Cijena: 298.100 €
listing.description_text_en:
Luxury studio apartment with a terrace – 298.100 €
The exclusive studio apartment is located in one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast, between Budva and Sveti Stefan, surrounded by Mediterranean vegetation, olive groves, and Miločer Park. Within a private complex of 10.000 m², this property offers a combination of comfort, privacy, and modern luxury.
The apartment has an internal area of 46,4 m², with an additional terrace of 7,8 m², making a total area of 54,2 m². A functional layout allows for optimal use of space, while the Mediterranean interior style, natural materials, and carefully selected details fit into the ambiance of a luxurious vacation.
The property is located in a complex that combines five-star hotel services and amenities designed for relaxation. Owners have access to a spa area, a panoramic swimming pool with a bar and sea view, a landscaped park, organized transfer to the beach, as well as concierge and security services available 24/7.
The apartment represents an interesting option for personal stay on the Montenegrin coast, but also for investment with the possibility of tourist rental, in accordance with management terms.
Price: 298.100 €

listing.title_text_en: Sale, studio apartment, 73m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description_text:
Studio apartman sa prostranom terasom – 471.250 €
Na atraktivnoj lokaciji između Budve i Svetog Stefana, u neposrednom okruženju parka Miločer i mediteranskog zelenila, nalazi se studio apartman koji spaja savremeni komfor i privatnost luksuznog kompleksa.
Apartman ima unutrašnju površinu od 47,4 m² i izuzetno prostranu terasu od 25,1 m², sa ukupno 72,5 m² površine. Terasa predstavlja značajnu prednost ove nekretnine, pružajući dodatni prostor za odmor, uživanje na otvorenom i stvaranje privatne zone za relaksaciju.
Enterijer je zamišljen u duhu mediteranske elegancije, sa prirodnim materijalima i pažljivo osmišljenim detaljima koji doprinose osjećaju udobnosti. U okviru kompleksa dostupni su spa zona, panoramski bazen sa barom i pogledom na more, uređeni park, transfer do plaže i profesionalne usluge konsijerža i obezbjeđenja 24/7.
Zahvaljujući velikoj terasi i ukupnoj površini, apartman je pogodan za kupce koji žele komfornu nekretninu za odmor, ali i za one koji razmatraju mogućnost turističkog izdavanja uz profesionalno upravljanje.
Cijena: 471.250 €
listing.description_text_en:
Studio apartment with a spacious terrace – 471.250 €
In an attractive location between Budva and Sveti Stefan, in the immediate vicinity of Miločer park and Mediterranean greenery, there is a studio apartment that combines contemporary comfort and the privacy of a luxury complex.
The apartment has an interior area of 47.4 m² and an exceptionally spacious terrace of 25.1 m², with a total area of 72.5 m². The terrace represents a significant advantage of this property, providing additional space for relaxation, outdoor enjoyment, and the creation of a private relaxation zone.
The interior is conceived in the spirit of Mediterranean elegance, with natural materials and carefully designed details that contribute to the feeling of comfort. Within the complex, a spa zone, a panoramic pool with a bar and sea view, a landscaped park, beach transfer, and professional concierge and security services 24/7 are available.
Thanks to the large terrace and total area, the apartment is suitable for buyers who desire a comfortable property for vacation, but also for those considering the possibility of tourist rental with professional management.
Price: 471.250 €

listing.title_text_en: Sale, studio apartment, 57m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description_text:
Studio apartman sa privatnom terasom – 369.200 €
Ovaj studio apartman nalazi se u ekskluzivnom kompleksu na crnogorskom primorju, između Budve i Svetog Stefana, okruženom mediteranskim zelenilom i prirodnim ljepotama parka Miločer. Lokacija pruža ravnotežu između privatnosti, opuštenog ambijenta i blizine najpoznatijih primorskih sadržaja.
Unutrašnja površina apartmana iznosi 40,6 m², dok terasa od 16,2 m² pruža dodatni prostor za boravak na otvorenom. Ukupna površina od 56,8 m² omogućava praktično korišćenje prostora, uz mogućnost organizacije udobnog enterijera prilagođenog potrebama vlasnika.
Projekat je osmišljen u skladu sa konceptom luksuznog apart-hotela, sa naglaskom na kvalitet, komfor i hotelsku uslugu. Vlasnicima su dostupni spa zona, panoramski bazen sa barom, uređeni park, organizovan transfer do plaže, kao i konsijerž i obezbjeđenje 24/7.
Apartman je pogodan za odmor, povremeni boravak ili investicionu kupovinu sa mogućnošću turističkog izdavanja, u zavisnosti od uslova upravljanja i tržišne potražnje.
Cijena: 369.200 €
listing.description_text_en:
Studio apartment with private terrace – 369.200 €
This studio apartment is located in an exclusive complex on the Montenegrin coast, between Budva and Sveti Stefan, surrounded by Mediterranean greenery and the natural beauty of Miločer park. The location offers a balance between privacy, a relaxed ambiance and proximity to the most famous coastal amenities.
The internal area of the apartment is 40,6 m², while the terrace of 16,2 m² provides additional outdoor living space. The total area of 56,8 m² allows for practical use of space, with the possibility of organizing a comfortable interior adapted to the owner's needs.
The project is designed in accordance with the concept of a luxury apart-hotel, with an emphasis on quality, comfort, and hotel service. Owners have access to a spa area, a panoramic pool with a bar, a landscaped park, organized transfer to the beach, as well as concierge and 24/7 security.
The apartment is suitable for vacation, occasional stays, or investment purchase with the possibility of tourist rental, depending on management conditions and market demand.
Price: 369.200 €

listing.title_text_en: Sale, studio apartment, 58m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description_text:

Kompleks je osmišljen kao spoj luksuznog stanovanja i hotelske usluge, sa sadržajima koji uključuju spa zonu, panoramski bazen sa barom i pogledom na more, uređeni park i organizovan transfer do plaže. Konsijerž i obezbjeđenje dostupni su 24/7.

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je nova luksuzna vila površine 200 m², smeštena na placu od 330 m² u mirnom i atraktivnom naselju Krašići, u opštini Tivat, svega 10 metara od plaže.
Krašići predstavljaju idealnu lokaciju za one koji traže privatnost, mir i neposrednu blizinu mora, daleko od gradske gužve, uz prelep pogled na Bokokotorski zaliv i okolne planine.
Posebnu vrednost ove vile čine panoramski pogled na more i planine iz svake sobe, privatni bazen i pažljivo osmišljen enterijer, u kojem su spojeni savremeni dizajn, kvalitetni materijali i visok nivo komfora.
Enterijer i opremljenostUnutrašnjost vile autorski je dizajnirana, sa više scenarija ambijentalnog osvetljenja koji prostoru daju poseban karakter. U završnoj obradi korišćene su italijanske keramičke pločice vrhunskog kvaliteta, dok su kupatila opremljena sanitarnom opremom renomiranih brendova Hansgrohe i Villeroy & Boch.
Vila poseduje savremene sisteme klimatizacije i ventilacije, podno grejanje i kamine, što omogućava prijatan boravak tokom cele godine.
Kvalitet gradnje i energetska efikasnostPrilikom izgradnje posebna pažnja posvećena je termoizolaciji i energetskoj efikasnosti. Ugrađeni su prozori sa dvostrukim zastakljenjem i kvalitetnim profilima renomiranog proizvođača Schüco, čime se doprinosi boljoj toplotnoj i zvučnoj izolaciji.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is a new luxury villa with an area of 200 m², located on a plot of 330 m² in the peaceful and attractive settlement of Krašići, in the municipality of Tivat, just 10 meters from the beach.
Krašići is an ideal location for those who seek privacy, peace and proximity to the sea, far from the hustle and bustle of the city, with a beautiful view of the Boka Bay and the surrounding mountains.
This villa is particularly valuable for its panoramic views of the sea and mountains from every room, a private pool and a carefully designed interior, which combines modern design, quality materials and a high level of comfort.
Interior and equipmentThe interior of the villa is author's designed, with multiple ambient lighting scenarios that give the space a special character. High-quality Italian ceramic tiles were used in the final treatment, while the bathrooms are equipped with sanitary ware from reputable brands Hansgrohe and Villeroy & Boch.
The villa has modern climate control and ventilation systems, underfloor heating and fireplaces, which make it possible to enjoy a pleasant stay throughout the year.
Quality of construction and energy efficiencySpecial attention was paid to thermal insulation and energy efficiency during construction. Double-glazed windows with high-quality profiles from the renowned manufacturer Schüco have been installed, which contribute to better thermal and sound insulation.

Najekskluzivnija kolekcija taunhausa u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smješteni na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i šampionksog golf terena Gary Player Design, taunhausovi stvaraju novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori – kombinaciju privatnosti vile, arhitekture na nivou resort residences i infrastrukture svjetske klase.
Dostupne opcije:

Svi taunhausovi se nude u fazi izgradnje sa završetkom radova u decembru 2028. godine.
Svaki taunhaus je dizajniran po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor“ – dnevne zone se neprimjetno prelivaju u prostrane terase, privatne bašte, lounge zone i bazene. Rasporedi odvajaju javne i privatne prostore na dva nivoa, stvarajući osjećaj odvojene vile sa maksimalnim komforom i privatnošću. U mnogim rezidencijama predviđene su dnevne sobe sa dvostrukim svjetlom, kamini, master spavaće sobe sa izlazom na panoramske terase, tehničke prostorije i prostrane zone za odlaganje.

Prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupno šampionkso golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena ogleda se u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pružaju panoramski pogledi na Jadransko more i Boku Kotorsku – što čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf zajednica sa morskim pogledima svjetskog nivoa.

listing.description_text_en:
The complex - Townhouses
The most exclusive collection of townhouses within the luxury community of Luštica Bay. Perched on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the championship Gary Player Design golf course, the complex townhouses create a new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a blend of villa privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available options:
• 3-bedroom townhouses • Area: 184–186 m² • Price: €2,524,000 – €2,643,000
All townhouses are offered at the construction stage, with completion scheduled for December 2028.
Each townhouse is designed with the concept of "indoor and outdoor living as one space" — living areas flow seamlessly into spacious terraces, private gardens, lounge zones, and pools. The layouts separate public and private spaces across two levels, creating the feel of a standalone villa with maximum comfort and privacy. Many residences feature double-height living rooms, fireplaces, master bedrooms with access to panoramic terraces, utility rooms, and ample storage areas.
Townhouse features:
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • private pools • landscaped gardens and green courtyards • summer kitchens and open dining areas • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • panoramic glazing • natural premium materials • designer kitchens by Nolte or similar premium level • Miele appliances • heated floors in bathrooms • air conditioning systems with wind protection • private parking spaces • electric vehicle charging • utility rooms and storage areas • Mediterranean-style architecture • high privacy of residences • location near the golf clubhouse and wellness center
The first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this caliber in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary Gary Player Design. The course's unique feature is that nearly every hole offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the Bay of Kotor — making the complex part of a rare category of golf communities with world-class sea views.
Townhouse owners receive full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• private beaches and beach clubs • marina with a promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restaurants, cafes, and boutiques • golf club and golf academy • practice golf course and golf simulator • spa center and wellness infrastructure • tennis and padel courts • sports fields and outdoor fitness areas • walking and cycling paths • 24/7 security and video surveillance • concierge service and property management services

The spaces are designed according to the concept of unity between indoor and outdoor environments: living areas seamlessly transition into spacious terraces and relaxation zones with views of the sea and the golf course.

listing.description_text:

Vila je izgrađena po principu „prostor bez osećaja gustine“. Ovde ima mnogo vazduha, svetlosti i otvorenih zona koje se glatko povezuju. Na prvom nivou se nalazi veliki dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom — jedinstven prostor za život, večere sa prijateljima i duge letnje večeri. Panoramski prozori pružaju izlaz na prostranu terasu, gde lako može da stane puna lounge-zona, trpezarijski sto i mesto za odmor pored mora.
Drugi nivo je u potpunosti posvećen privatnom delu kuće. Četiri odvojene spavaće sobe, nekoliko kupatila, master-blok sa sopstvenim kupatilom i garderobom. Raspored je napravljen tako da čak i pri punom smeštaju porodice ili gostiju kuća ne gubi osećaj privatnosti.
Donji nivo uključuje dodatne prostorije koje se mogu prilagoditi za kućnu teretanu, wellness-zonu, kućni bioskop, vinsku sobu ili odvojene gostinske prostore. Postoji privatna garaža i tehničke prostorije — retkost za, gde je većina objekata predstavljena apartmanima.
Enterijeri su izvedeni u modernoj mediteranskoj estetici: prirodni kamen, tople teksture, mirna paleta, velikoformatno zastakljivanje. Kuća se ne oseća kao „odmarališna nekretnina“, već kao punopravna rezidencija za život pored mora.

Kompleks je centralna šetališta Luštica Bay, izgrađena oko jahting marine, restorana i promenade za šetnju. Ovo je najživlji deo kompleksa, ali su vile smeštene tako da zadrže privatnost i osećaj zatvorenog kluba.

listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a 4-bedroom villa in the complex, Luštica Bay — one of the most exclusive and prestigious residences on the coast of Montenegro.
Key features:
• Total area: 416.5 m² • Terraces and outdoor spaces: 242.05 m² • Bedrooms: 4 • Bathrooms: 4+ • Type: villa • Floors: 3 levels • Garage: private garage
About the villa:
The villa is designed on the principle of "space without a sense of density." It features plenty of air, light, and open areas that seamlessly connect with each other. On the first level, there is a large living room with a kitchen and dining area — a unified space for living, dinners with friends, and long summer evenings. Panoramic windows open onto a spacious terrace, which can easily accommodate a full lounge area, dining table, and a relaxation spot by the sea.
The second level is entirely dedicated to the private part of the house. Four separate bedrooms, several bathrooms, and a master suite with its own bathroom and dressing room. The layout is designed so that even when the house is fully occupied by family or guests, it retains a sense of privacy.
The lower level includes additional rooms that can be adapted into a home gym, wellness area, home cinema, wine room, or separate guest spaces. There is a private garage and utility rooms — a rarity for the complex, where most properties are apartments.
The interiors are designed in a modern Mediterranean aesthetic: natural stone, warm textures, a calm palette, and large-format glazing. The house feels not like "resort real estate," but like a full-fledged residence for living by the sea.
About the area:
The complex is the central promenade of Luštica Bay, built around a yacht marina, restaurants, and a walking promenade. It is the most vibrant part of the complex, yet the villas are positioned to maintain privacy and a sense of an exclusive club.
Within walking distance:
• Yacht marina and promenade • Restaurants and wine bars • Boutiques and concept stores • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • Beaches and beach clubs • Wellness and fitness infrastructure • Supermarkets and everyday services
Property owners receive access to the entire Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• Golf club and golf academy • Golf simulator and training areas • Spa complex and wellness center • Tennis and padel courts • Concierge service • Property management services • 24/7 security and video surveillance • Pedestrian and cycling routes along the coast
Location:
• Tivat Airport — about 15 minutes by car • Kotor — about 20 minutes • Budva — about 35 minutes • Direct access to beaches and Luštica Bay infrastructure
Investment potential:
Villas of this scale within the complex represent an extremely limited market segment. The large area, full-house format, private garage, and location near the marina make this property rare even by Luštica Bay standards. Such residences are in demand not only for personal use but also among international buyers considering real estate as a long-term asset on the Adriatic.

• Površina: 50,93 m² • Kupatilo: 1 • Sprat: 4 • Format: apartmani
O apartmanima:
Raspored uključuje prostranu spavaću sobu, odvojenu dnevnu zonu sa mekim nameštajem, kupatilo i predsoblje. Zahvaljujući povećanoj površini u poređenju sa standardnim hotelskim sobama, apartmani pružaju viši nivo komfora kako za lični odmor, tako i za duži boravak.
Veliko panoramsko zastakljivanje ispunjava prostor prirodnom svetlošću i stvara osećaj otvorenosti. Raspored omogućava udobno smeštanje kompletne zone za spavanje i odvojenog prostora za odmor i prijem gostiju.
Enterijeri su urađeni u modernom stilu uz korišćenje prirodnih materijala, kvalitetne završne obrade i opreme koja odgovara standardima međunarodnog hotelskog operatera.
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• Recepcija i 24-časovna usluga • Lobi bar • Restoran • SPA centar • Fitnes sala • Panoramski bazen • Room Service • Butici i komercijalni prostori • Parking • Konsijerž servis • Profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje
Lokacija:
• Centralni trg Kolašina — oko 100 m • Prodavnice, restorani i gradska infrastruktura — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Ski centar Kolašin 1450 — oko 11 km • Ski centar Kolašin 1600 — oko 13 km • Nacionalni park Biogradska gora — oko 20 km • Aerodrom Podgorica — oko 60 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kolašin je jedan od ključnih centara razvoja planinskog turizma u Crnoj Gori. Aktivni razvoj ski infrastrukture, celogodišnji turistički promet i ograničena ponuda kvalitetnih nekretnina stvaraju visoku potražnju za objektima ovakvog formata. Apartmani u kompleksu kojim upravlja međunarodni brend omogućavaju vlasniku da kombinuje lično korišćenje nekretnine sa mogućnošću ostvarivanja prihoda od izdavanja putem profesionalne kompanije za upravljanje.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale apartments in a modern hotel and residential complex managed by an international brand. The project is located in the very center of Kolašin and combines a high level of service, developed infrastructure, and the investment potential of one of the fastest-growing mountain resorts in Montenegro.
Key features:
• Area: 50.93 m² • Bathroom: 1 • Floor: 4 • Format: apartments
About the apartments:
The layout includes a spacious bedroom, a separate living area with upholstered furniture, a bathroom, and an entrance hall. Due to the increased area compared to standard hotel rooms, the apartments provide a higher level of comfort both for personal vacations and for long-term stays.
Large panoramic glazing fills the space with natural light and creates a feeling of openness. The layout allows for the comfortable placement of a full-fledged sleeping area and a separate space for relaxation and receiving guests.
The interiors are designed in a modern style using natural materials, high-quality finishes, and equipment that meets the standards of an international hotel operator.
Complex infrastructure:
• Reception and 24/7 service • Lobby bar • Restaurant • SPA center • Fitness room • Panoramic pool • Room Service • Boutiques and commercial premises • Parking • Concierge service • Professional hotel management
Location:
• Kolašin central square — about 100 m • Shops, restaurants, and city infrastructure — within walking distance • Kolašin 1450 Ski Center — about 11 km • Kolašin 1600 Ski Center — about 13 km • Biogradska Gora National Park — about 20 km • Podgorica Airport — about 60 km
Investment potential:
Kolašin is one of the key centers for the development of mountain tourism in Montenegro. The active development of ski infrastructure, year-round tourist flow, and limited supply of quality real estate create high demand for properties of this format. Apartments in a complex managed by an international brand allow the owner to combine personal use of the property with the possibility of generating rental income through a professional management company.

listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju apartman sa 1 spavaćom sobom u modernom kondo-hotelu u centru Kolašina. Objekat kombinuje mogućnost ličnog korišćenja, profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje i investicioni potencijal jednog od najbrže rastućih planinskih odmarališta u Crnoj Gori.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 40,53 m² • Spavaće sobe: 1 • Kupatilo: 1 • Sprat: 4 • Format: apartman sa odvojenom spavaćom sobom
O apartmanu:
Raspored uključuje odvojenu spavaću sobu, dnevni boravak, kupatilo i prostranu terasu. Zahvaljujući poziciji na četvrtom spratu i ugaonoj konfiguraciji, apartman se odlikuje dobrom osunčanošću i povećanom površinom zastakljenja.
Spavaća zona je odvojena od dnevnog boravka, što objekat čini udobnijim za duži boravak u poređenju sa standardnim hotelskim sobama. Prostor je dizajniran u modernom planinskom stilu sa akcentom na prirodne materijale, tople teksture i funkcionalnost.
Apartman je deo hotelskog kompleksa međunarodnog nivoa i može se koristiti kako za sopstveni odmor, tako i za ostvarivanje prihoda od izdavanja kroz profesionalno upravljanje.
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• Recepcija • Lobi bar • Restoran • SPA centar • Fitnes sala • Panoramski bazen • Room Service • Butici • Parking • Transfer do ski centara • Profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje
Lokacija:
• Centar Kolašina • Glavni gradski trg — oko 100 m • Restorani, kafići i prodavnice — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Ski centar Kolašin 1450 — oko 11 km • Ski centar Kolašin 1600 — oko 13 km • Aerodrom Podgorica — oko 60 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kolašin ostaje jedna od najdinamičnije razvijajućih turističkih destinacija u Crnoj Gori zahvaljujući razvoju ski infrastrukture i celogodišnjeg turizma. Apartmani sa odvojenom spavaćom sobom uživaju stabilnu potražnju među gostima odmarališta, a format kondo-hotela omogućava kombinovanje ličnog korišćenja nekretnine sa ostvarivanjem prihoda od izdavanja pod upravom međunarodnog hotelskog operatera. Projekat predviđa garantovanu profitabilnost i profesionalno upravljanje, što objekat čini atraktivnim kako za investitore, tako i za kupce koji traže sopstvenu nekretninu na planini.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a 1-bedroom apartment in a modern condo-hotel in the center of Kolašin. The property combines the opportunity for personal use, professional hotel management, and the investment potential of one of Montenegro's fastest-growing mountain resorts.
Key features:
• Area: 40.53 m² • Bedrooms: 1 • Bathroom: 1 • Floor: 4 • Format: apartment with a separate bedroom
About the apartment:
The layout includes a separate bedroom, a living/lounge area, a bathroom, and a spacious terrace. Due to its location on the fourth floor and corner configuration, the apartment features excellent natural light and increased glazing area.
The sleeping area is separated from the living room, making the property more comfortable for long-term stays compared to standard hotel rooms. The space is designed in a modern mountain style with an emphasis on natural materials, warm textures, and functionality.
The apartment is part of an international-level hotel complex and can be used both for personal vacations and for generating rental income through professional management.
Complex infrastructure:
• Reception • Lobby bar • Restaurant • SPA center • Fitness room • Panoramic pool • Room Service • Boutiques • Parking • Shuttle to ski centers • Professional hotel management
Location:
• Center of Kolašin • Main city square — about 100 m • Restaurants, cafes, and shops — within walking distance • Kolašin 1450 ski center — about 11 km • Kolašin 1600 ski center — about 13 km • Podgorica Airport — about 60 km
Investment potential:
Kolašin remains one of the most dynamically developing tourist destinations in Montenegro due to the development of ski infrastructure and year-round tourism. One-bedroom apartments enjoy stable demand among resort guests, and the condo-hotel format allows combining personal use of the property with rental income under the management of an international hotel operator. The project provides for guaranteed returns and professional management, making the property attractive both for investors and for buyers looking for their own real estate in the mountains.

listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju brendiranu rezidenciju u okviru hotela sa pet zvezdica The Chedi Luštica Bay — jedne od najprepoznatljivijih hotelskih adresa na crnogorskom primorju, smeštene u centru marine Luštica Bay.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 47 m² • Kategorija: Grand Deluxe soba sa pogledom na more • Spavaća soba: 1, predviđena za 2 odrasle osobe i dete • Balkon: sopstveni, sa pogledom na more i marinu • Očekivani godišnji prinos: 4–5%
O sobi:
Soba je uređena u svetloj, mirnoj paleti boja — terasa keramika na podu, detalji od hrastovine, panoramski prozori od poda do plafona i sopstveni balkon sa pogledom na more i jahte u marini. Soba poseduje mini-kuhinju, kadu i tuš sa kišnim efektom, Wi-Fi i kompletan set hotelskih pogodnosti.
O kompleksu:
The Chedi Luštica Bay — hotel sa pet zvezdica u centru marine Luštica Bay, na poluostrvu Luštica, u blizini Tivta. Na teritoriji se nalaze otvoreni i zatvoreni bazeni, spa centar, restorani, barovi, sopstvena plaža i razvijena infrastruktura marine sa jahtama, restoranima i prodavnicama.
Lokacija:
• Marina Luštica Bay — na teritoriji kompleksa • Svetionik i šetalište — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Tivat — na nekoliko minuta vožnje
Investicioni potencijal:
Soba učestvuje u programu iznajmljivanja kojim upravlja hotel, što kupovinu pretvara u gotov aktiv koji ne zahteva samostalno upravljanje, sa očekivanim prinosom od 4–5% godišnje. Format brendirane rezidencije pri hotelu sa pet zvezdica u jednom od najtraženijih projekata na crnogorskom primorju kombinuje investicionu komponentu sa mogućnošću ličnog korišćenja sobe.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a branded residence within the five-star The Chedi Luštica Bay hotel — one of the most recognizable hotel addresses on the Montenegrin coast, located in the heart of the Luštica Bay marina.
Key features:
• Area: 47 m² • Category: Grand Deluxe Room with a sea view • Bedroom: 1, designed for 2 adults and a child • Balcony: private, with a view of the sea and the marina • Expected annual yield: 4–5%
About the room:
The room is designed in a light, calm color palette — terrazzo ceramic flooring, oak details, floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, and a private balcony with views of the sea and the yachts in the marina. The room features a kitchenette, a bathtub and a rain shower, Wi-Fi, and a full range of hotel amenities.
About the complex:
The Chedi Luštica Bay is a five-star hotel in the center of the Luštica Bay marina, on the Luštica peninsula, near Tivat. The premises include indoor and outdoor pools, a spa center, restaurants, bars, a private beach, and the developed infrastructure of the marina with yachts, restaurants, and shops.
Location:
• Luštica Bay Marina — on the territory of the complex • Lighthouse and promenade — within walking distance • Tivat — a few minutes' drive away
Investment potential:
The room participates in a hotel-managed rental program, which turns the purchase into a turnkey asset that requires no self-administration, with an expected yield of 4–5% per year. The branded residence format at a five-star hotel in one of the most sought-after projects on the Montenegrin coast combines an investment component with the possibility of personal use of the room.

listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju stilski studio sa terasom i pogledom na more — u zatvorenom rezidencijalnom kompleksu na obali Boke Kotorske, u zoni pod zaštitom UNESCO-a.
Ključne karakteristike:
• Ukupna površina: 33,16 m² • Terasa: 4,70 m² • Sprat: 1. (punopravni stambeni sprat, ne suteren) • Raspored: predsoblje sa garderobom, kupatilo, objedinjena dnevna zona (dnevna soba-kuhinja-trpezarija) sa izlazom na terasu • Stalan, ničim neprekinut pogled na more • Čuvana zatvorena teritorija sa bazenom, liftom i podzemnim parkingom (mjesto se kupuje posebno — 30.000 €)
O stanu:
Kompaktan i promišljen raspored studija projektovan je za udoban život ili izdavanje. Prostrana dnevna zona objedinjuje kuhinju, dnevnu sobu i trpezariju, sa direktnim izlazom na terasu — odakle se pruža pogled na zaliv. Odvojeno predsoblje sa prostorom za garderobu i kompletno kupatilo upotpunjuju funkcionalnost prostora. Gradnja se izvodi korišćenjem prirodnih materijala i energetski efikasnih sistema.
Lokacija:
• Grota Beach Bar & Restaurant — oko 150 m • Plaža Orahovac Beach — oko 275 m • Hotel Casa del Mare — oko 375 m • Restoran Casa del Mare — oko 385 m • Autobuska stanica (linija Kotor–Perast) — oko 390 m • Prodavnica prehrambenih proizvoda Viva Market (Dobrota) — oko 1,4 km • Perast — oko 4,1 km • Istorijski centar Kotora — oko 7,5 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kupovina se vrši direktno od investitora — bez poreza na prenos prava svojine pri prvoj prodaji. Kompaktan format i status studija čine jedinicu atraktivnom kako za ličnu upotrebu, tako i za uključivanje u program upravljanog iznajmljivanja sa potencijalom stabilnog turističkog prihoda. Završetak izgradnje očekuje se do kraja oktobra 2026. godine.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a stylish studio with a terrace and sea view — in a gated residential complex on the shore of the Bay of Kotor, in a UNESCO-protected zone.
Key features:
• Total area: 33.16 m² • Terrace: 4.70 m² • Floor: 1st (full residential floor, not basement) • Layout: hallway with wardrobe, bathroom, combined day zone (living room-kitchen-dining area) with access to the terrace • Permanent, unobstructed sea view • Secure gated area with pool, elevator, and underground parking (parking space purchased separately — €30,000)
About the apartment:
The compact and well-thought-out studio layout is designed for comfortable living or rental. The spacious day zone combines kitchen, living room, and dining area, with direct access to the terrace — offering a view of the bay. A separate hallway with wardrobe space and a full bathroom complete the functionality. Construction uses natural materials and energy-efficient systems.
Location:
• Grota Beach Bar & Restaurant — about 150 m • Orahovac Beach — about 275 m • Hotel Casa del Mare — about 375 m • Restaurant Casa del Mare — about 385 m • Bus stop (Kotor–Perast line) — about 390 m • Viva Market grocery store (Dobrota) — about 1.4 km • Perast — about 4.1 km • Historic center of Kotor — about 7.5 km
Investment potential:
Purchase is made directly from the developer — no property transfer tax on the primary sale. The compact format and studio status make the unit attractive both for personal use and for inclusion in a managed rental program with potential for stable tourist income. Construction completion is expected by the end of October 2026.

listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju dvosobni penthaus na poslednjem spratu zatvorenog rezidencijalnog kompleksa na obali Kotorskog zaliva — sa prostranom otvorenom terasom i panoramskim pogledom na more.
Ključne karakteristike:
• Ukupna površina stana: 55,39 m² • Otvorena terasa: 31,28 m² (dodatno, ne ulazi u površinu stana) • Sprat: 2. (gornji, mansardni nivo kompleksa) • Raspored: 2 spavaće sobe, 1 kupatilo + odvojen toalet, predsoblje sa garderobom, dodatna garderobna zona (degazman), objedinjena dnevna zona • Stalan, ničim neprekinut pogled na more • Čuvana zatvorena teritorija sa bazenom, liftom i podzemnim parkingom (mesto se kupuje posebno, 30.000 €)
O stanu:
Potpuni dvosobni raspored sa promišljenom podelom privatnih i zajedničkih zona: dve spavaće sobe (9,75 m² i 11,35 m²), prostrana dnevna zona 19,20 m² koja objedinjuje kuhinju, dnevnu sobu i trpezariju. Sanitarni čvor je podeljen na kupatilo i odvojen toalet — pogodno za porodični život. Dodatna garderobna zona (degazman) na putu od predsoblja do spavaćih soba dodaje funkcionalnost. Glavna karakteristika stana je otvorena terasa površine 31,28 m², koja izlazi na dnevnu zonu i nastavlja stambeni prostor napolje, sa panoramskim pogledom na zaliv. Položaj na gornjem spratu kompleksa obezbeđuje maksimalno otvoren pogled. Gradnja se izvodi korišćenjem prirodnih materijala i energetski efikasnih sistema.
Lokacija:
• Grota Beach Bar & Restaurant — oko 150 m • Plaža Orahovac Beach — oko 275 m • Hotel Casa del Mare — oko 375 m • Restoran Casa del Mare — oko 385 m • Autobuska stanica (linija Kotor–Perast) — oko 390 m • Prodavnica prehrambenih proizvoda Viva Market (Dobrota) — oko 1,4 km • Perast — oko 4,1 km • Istorijski centar Kotora — oko 7,5 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kupovina se vrši direktno od investitora — bez poreza na prenos prava svojine pri prvoj prodaji. Format penthausa sa dve spavaće sobe i prostranom terasom čini stan privlačnim kako za stalni život velike porodice, tako i za uključivanje u program upravljanog iznajmljivanja — zbog karakteristika pogleda, ovakve jedinice obično pokazuju najveću potražnju u turističkom iznajmljivanju. Završetak izgradnje očekuje se do kraja oktobra 2026. godine.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a two-bedroom penthouse on the top floor of a gated residential complex on the shore of the Bay of Kotor — with a spacious open terrace and panoramic sea views.
Key features:
• Total apartment area: 55.39 m² • Open terrace: 31.28 m² (additional, not included in the apartment area) • Floor: 2nd (top, attic level of the complex) • Layout: 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom + separate toilet, hallway with wardrobe, additional dressing area (dressing room), combined day zone • Permanent, unobstructed sea view • Gated secure territory with pool, elevator, and underground parking (parking space purchased separately, €30,000)
About the apartment:
Full two-bedroom layout with thoughtful separation of private and common areas: two bedrooms (9.75 m² and 11.35 m²), a spacious day zone of 19.20 m² combining kitchen, living room, and dining area. The bathroom is divided into a bathroom and a separate toilet — convenient for family living. An additional dressing area (dressing room) on the way from the hallway to the bedrooms adds functionality. The main feature of the apartment is an open terrace of 31.28 m², adjacent to the day zone and extending the living space outdoors, with panoramic views of the bay. The location on the top floor of the complex ensures the most open view. Construction uses natural materials and energy-efficient systems.
Location:
• Grota Beach Bar & Restaurant — about 150 m • Orahovac Beach — about 275 m • Casa del Mare Hotel — about 375 m • Casa del Mare Restaurant — about 385 m • Bus stop (Kotor–Perast line) — about 390 m • Viva Market grocery store (Dobrota) — about 1.4 km • Perast — about 4.1 km • Kotor Old Town — about 7.5 km
Investment potential:
Purchase is made directly from the developer — no property transfer tax on the primary sale. The penthouse format with two bedrooms and a spacious terrace makes the apartment attractive both for permanent residence by a large family and for inclusion in a managed rental program — due to the view characteristics, such units typically show the highest demand in tourist rentals. Construction is expected to be completed by the end of October 2026.

listing.description_text:
Predlažemo na prodaju stan sa dve spavaće sobe u naselju u okviru stambenog kompleksa Lustica Bay — centralnom stambenom kvartu sa razvijenom svakodnevnom infrastrukturom i besplatnim pristupom plažama Lustica Bay za stanare.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 80 m² • Spavaće sobe: 2 • Kupatila: 2 • Parking: ima • Moderna obrada
O naselju:
Kompleks je centar svakodnevnog života Lustica Bay: prodavnice, apoteka, kafići, restorani i trg sa živom atmosferom na samom pragu. Naselje je projektovano za celogodišnji život, a ne samo za sezonski odmor. Stanari imaju besplatan pristup plažama Lustica Bay.
Lokacija:
• Restoran by Angsana — na trgu • Restoran Noa Lustica Bay — oko 3,2 km • The Spot at The Chedi — oko 2,9 km • Plaža The Chedi Lustica Bay — oko 3,8 km • Aerodrom Tivat — oko 10 km • Porto Montenegro — oko 9 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Lustica Bay je jedan od najvećih razvojnih projekata na Jadranu, koji nastavlja aktivno da se razvija. Kompleks kao stambeni kvart sa infrastrukturom za stalni boravak privlači i porodice i investitore orijentisane na dugoročni najam — posebno imajući u vidu da potražnja za kvalitetnim stanovanjem u Lustica Bay stabilno raste zajedno sa razvojem projekta.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a two-bedroom apartment in the area of the Lustica Bay residential complex — a central residential neighborhood with developed everyday infrastructure and free access to Lustica Bay beaches for residents.
Key features:
• Area: 80 m² • Bedrooms: 2 • Bathrooms: 2 • Parking: yes • Modern finishes
About the area:
The complex is the center of everyday life at Lustica Bay: shops, a pharmacy, cafes, restaurants and a lively square right on your doorstep. The area is designed for year-round living, not just seasonal holidays. Residents have free access to Lustica Bay beaches.
Location:
• The complex by Angsana restaurant — on the complex square • Noa Lustica Bay restaurant — about 3.2 km • The Spot at The Chedi — about 2.9 km • The Chedi Lustica Bay beach — about 3.8 km • Tivat Airport — about 10 km • Porto Montenegro — about 9 km
Investment potential:
Lustica Bay is one of the largest development projects on the Adriatic, which continues to actively develop. The complex, as a residential neighborhood with infrastructure for permanent living, attracts both families and investors focused on long-term rentals — especially given that demand for quality housing in Lustica Bay is steadily growing along with the development of the project.

listing.description_text:
Kompleks - Golf Villas
Kompleks Villas predstavljaju najekskluzivniju kolekciju rezidencija u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smještene na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i golf terena Gary Player Design, vile stvaraju potpuno novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori - kombinaciju privatnosti, arhitekture na nivou resort rezidencija i infrastrukture svjetske klase.
Dostupne opcije
Vile sa 3 spavaće sobe
• Površina: 275–352 m² • Cijena: €3,442,000 – €4,198,000
Vile sa 4 spavaće sobe
• Površina: 322–386 m² • Cijena: €3,931,000 – €4,232,000
Vile sa 5 spavaćih soba
• Površina: 400 m² • Cijena: €5,076,000
Svaka vila je projektovana po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor" - dnevne zone se glatko prelivaju u prostrane terase, infinity bazene, privatne bašte i otvorene dining zone. U mnogim planovima predviđeni su dnevni boravci sa duplom visinom, master spavaće sobe sa garderobama, prostrana kupatila, kućne kancelarije, tehničke prostorije i podzemne garaže.
Karakteristike vila
• panoramski pogledi na more i golf teren • infinity bazeni • privatne pejzažne bašte • Ljetne kuhinje i sjenice • prostrane kamene terase • open-space dnevni boravci i dining zone • kamini u dnevnim boravcima • panoramsko zastakljivanje • prirodni premium materijali • dizajnerske kuhinje premium nivoa • Miele uređaji • podno grijanje • Privatne garaže i sistemi za skladištenje • kućne kancelarije i tehničke prostorije • arhitektura Block722 • visoka privatnost rezidencija • prostorije za skladištenje opreme za golf
Kompleks je prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupa šampionatsko golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena je u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pruža pogled na more - što ga čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf terena sa panoramskim morskim pogledima sa svake tačke igre.
Vlasnici vila dobijaju potpuni pristup cjelokupnoj infrastrukturi Luštica Bay:
• privatne plaže i beach klubovi • marina village i šetalište • 5-zvjezdani hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restorani, kafići i butici • golf clubhouse i golf akademija • driving range i golf simulator • spa i wellness sadržaji • teniski i padel tereni • sportski tereni i outdoor teretane • staze za planinarenje i biciklizam • 24-časovno obezbjeđenje i video nadzor • koncijerž i usluge upravljanja nekretninama
listing.description_text_en:
The complex - Golf Villas
The complex Villas are the most exclusive collection of residences within the Luštica Bay luxury community. Situated on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the Gary Player Design golf course, the villas create a completely new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a combination of privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available Options
3-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 275–352 m² • Price: €3,442,000 – €4,198,000
4-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 322–386 m² • Price: €3,931,000 – €4,232,000
5-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 400 m² • Price: €5,076,000
Each villa is designed according to the concept of "living inside and outside as a single space" — living areas seamlessly flow into spacious terraces, infinity pools, private gardens, and open dining zones. Many layouts feature double-height living rooms, master bedrooms with walk-in closets, spacious bathrooms, home offices, utility rooms, and underground garages.
Villa Features
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • infinity pools • private landscaped gardens • summer kitchens and gazebos • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living rooms and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • floor-to-ceiling glazing • natural premium materials • designer premium kitchens • Miele appliances • underfloor heating • private garages and storage systems • home offices and utility rooms • architecture by Block722 • high privacy of residences • golf equipment storage rooms
The complex is the first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this level in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary company Gary Player Design. A unique feature of the course is that almost every hole offers sea views, making it part of a rare category of golf courses with panoramic sea views from every point of play.
Villa owners have full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• private beaches and beach clubs • marina village and promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restaurants, cafes, and boutiques • golf clubhouse and golf academy • driving range and golf simulator • spa and wellness facilities • tennis and padel courts • sports fields and outdoor gyms • hiking and biking trails • 24/7 security and video surveillance • concierge and property management services

listing.description_text:
Na sjeverozapadu Istre, u Savudriji, nalazi se Petram Resort & Residences, najluksuzniji resort na hrvatskoj obali i jedinstven projekt koji spaja suvremenu arhitekturu, vrhunsku udobnost i investicijsku sigurnost. Ovo je mjesto gdje vlasništvo nad apartmanom znači mnogo više od same nekretnine, to je ulazak u svijet prestižnog lifestylea, privatnosti i luksuznog odmora. Vlasnici mogu uživati u svim pogodnostima svjetski poznatog resorta, dok u isto vrijeme ostvaruju stabilan prihod kroz profesionalno organiziran program najma. Petram Resort & Residences zamišljen je kao destinacija za hedoniste, obitelji i investitore koji traže luksuz bez kompromisa.
Apartmani
U glavnoj zgradi resorta smješteno je 179 apartmana različitog tipa. Svi apartmani imaju vlastite terase s pogledom na more ili mediteransko zelenilo, a interijeri su uređeni u suvremenom stilu s naglaskom na eleganciju i prirodne materijale. Svaka jedinica opremljena je modernom kuhinjom, kupaonicama s podnim grijanjem, perilicom i sušilicom rublja, pametnim TV sustavom, sigurnosnim sefom te brzim bežičnim internetom. Posebna pažnja posvećena je detaljima koji stvaraju osjećaj doma i luksuznog hotela u jednom, od kvalitetnih materijala do personaliziranih usluga poput dječje opreme ili sadržaja za kućne ljubimce na zahtjev.
Najam i investicija
Vlasništvo u Petram Resort & Residencesu je pametna investicija. Cijeli kompleks nudi profesionalno upravljanje nekretninama i rental program koji se brine za rezervacije, prijave gostiju, čišćenje, održavanje i marketing. Time se vlasnicima omogućuje potpuno bezbrižno upravljanje apartmanom. Zahvaljujući prestižnoj lokaciji i izuzetno visokoj potražnji za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, apartmani generiraju godišnje prinose od 5 do 7 posto, uz fleksibilnost da vlasnici u odabranim razdobljima uživaju u vlastitom apartmanu. Na taj način nekretnina postaje i osobno zadovoljstvo i izvor stabilnog prihoda.
Resort i lifestyle
Život u Petram Resortu donosi iskustvo najviše svjetske razine. Najveći krovni infinity bazen u Europi, dugačak 105 metara, nudi impresivne poglede na Piranski zaljev i nezaboravne zalaske sunca. Na krovu se smjestio i fine dining restoran koji spaja internacionalnu i istarsku kuhinju, dok ljetna trattoria unosi opušteni talijanski šarm. Spa i wellness centar prostire se na više razina te uključuje unutarnji grijani bazen, pet sauna s panoramskim pogledom na more, luksuzne masažne tretmane i privatne spa apartmane za parove. Resort raspolaže i privatnom plažom, fitness centrom, dječjim bazenima i igralištima, a samo pet minuta udaljen je od najvećeg golf terena u Hrvatskoj s 18 rupa. Vlasnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su i 24-satna recepcija, konsijerž, električni buggy prijevoz unutar resorta, usluga parkiranja i sigurnost na najvišoj razini.
Lokacija
Savudrija, smještena na sjeverozapadnom rtu Istre, poznata je po svojoj tišini, netaknutoj prirodi i bogatoj povijesti. Najstariji svjetionik na Jadranu, čarobni vinogradi i maslinici te šarmantni srednjovjekovni gradići u neposrednoj blizini čine ovu lokaciju posebnom. Savudrija nudi kombinaciju mirnog mediteranskog okruženja i iznimne prometne povezanosti, Trst je udaljen 94 kilometra, Ljubljana 135, Venecija 202, Zagreb 275, a Beč 515 kilometara. Zahvaljujući blizini nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka, Petram Resort je lako dostupan klijentima iz cijele Europe, što dodatno povećava atraktivnost investicije.
OPIS APARTMANA
Apartman A-29 – 2. kat – stambena površina 80,80 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + kupaonica + wc) + balkon (10,10 m2 - pogled park) + vanjsko parking mjesto broj 198, obračunska neto površina 88,80 = 756.085,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Apartmani u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju priliku da spojite luksuzni mediteranski život, osobno zadovoljstvo i stabilan prihod od najma, u najluksuznijem resortu na hrvatskoj obali.
listing.description_text_en:
In the northwest of Istria, in Savudrija, the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast and a unique project that combines contemporary architecture, top comfort, and investment security. This is a place where apartment ownership means much more than just real estate; it is an entry into a world of prestigious lifestyle, privacy, and luxurious vacation. Owners can enjoy all the amenities of a world-renowned resort while simultaneously generating stable income through a professionally organized rental program. Designed as a destination for hedonists, families, and investors seeking uncompromising luxury.
Apartments
The main resort building houses 179 apartments of various types. All apartments have private terraces with views of the sea or Mediterranean greenery, and the interiors are designed in a contemporary style emphasizing elegance and natural materials. Each unit is equipped with a modern kitchen, bathrooms with underfloor heating, a washer and dryer, a smart TV system, a security safe, and high-speed wireless internet. Special attention is given to details that create a feeling of home and luxury hotel combined, from high-quality materials to personalized services such as children's equipment or pet amenities upon request.
Rental and Investment
Ownership is a smart investment. The entire complex offers professional property management and a rental program that handles bookings, guest check-ins, cleaning, maintenance, and marketing. This allows owners completely worry-free apartment management. Thanks to the prestigious location and exceptionally high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, the apartments generate annual returns of 5 to 7 percent, with the flexibility for owners to enjoy their apartment during selected periods. This way, the property becomes both a personal pleasure and a source of stable income.
Resort and Lifestyle
Living at Resort offers an experience of the highest global standards. The largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, 105 meters long, offers impressive views of the Piran Bay and unforgettable sunsets. On the roof, there is also a fine dining restaurant combining international and Istrian cuisine, while the summer trattoria brings a relaxed Italian charm. The spa and wellness center spans multiple levels and includes an indoor heated pool, five saunas with panoramic sea views, luxurious massage treatments, and private spa apartments for couples. The resort also features a private beach, fitness center, children's pools, and playgrounds, and is only five minutes away from the largest golf course in Croatia with 18 holes. Owners and guests have access to 24-hour reception, concierge service, electric buggy transport within the resort, parking services, and top-level security.
Location
Savudrija, located on the northwestern tip of Istria, is known for its tranquility, unspoiled nature, and rich history. The oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic, enchanting vineyards and olive groves, and charming medieval towns in the immediate vicinity make this location special. Savudrija offers a combination of a peaceful Mediterranean environment and excellent transport connections; Trieste is 94 kilometers away, Ljubljana 135, Venice 202, Zagreb 275, and Vienna 515 kilometers. Thanks to the proximity of several international airports. APARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Apartment A-29 – 2nd floor – living area 80.80 m2 (2 bedrooms + bathroom + WC) + balcony (10.10 m2 - park view) + outdoor parking space number 198, calculated net area 88.80 = 756,085.00 EUR (including furniture)
Apartments at Resort represent an opportunity to combine luxurious Mediterranean living, personal satisfaction, and stable rental income in the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast.

Vlasnici mogu uživati u svim pogodnostima svjetski poznatog resorta, dok u isto vrijeme ostvaruju stabilan prihod kroz profesionalno organiziran program najma. Petram Resort & Residences zamišljen je kao destinacija za hedoniste, obitelji i investitore koji traže luksuz bez kompromisa.
Apartmani
U glavnoj zgradi resorta smješteno je 179 apartmana različitog tipa. Svi apartmani imaju vlastite terase s pogledom na more ili mediteransko zelenilo, a interijeri su uređeni u suvremenom stilu s naglaskom na eleganciju i prirodne materijale. Svaka jedinica opremljena je modernom kuhinjom, kupaonicama s podnim grijanjem, perilicom i sušilicom rublja, pametnim TV sustavom, sigurnosnim sefom te brzim bežičnim internetom. Posebna pažnja posvećena je detaljima koji stvaraju osjećaj doma i luksuznog hotela u jednom, od kvalitetnih materijala do personaliziranih usluga poput dječje opreme ili sadržaja za kućne ljubimce na zahtjev.
Najam i investicija
Vlasništvo u Petram Resort & Residencesu je pametna investicija. Cijeli kompleks nudi profesionalno upravljanje nekretninama i rental program koji se brine za rezervacije, prijave gostiju, čišćenje, održavanje i marketing. Time se vlasnicima omogućuje potpuno bezbrižno upravljanje apartmanom. Zahvaljujući prestižnoj lokaciji i izuzetno visokoj potražnji za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, apartmani generiraju godišnje prinose od 5 do 7 posto, uz fleksibilnost da vlasnici u odabranim razdobljima uživaju u vlastitom apartmanu. Na taj način nekretnina postaje i osobno zadovoljstvo i izvor stabilnog prihoda.
Resort i lifestyle
Život u Petram Resortu donosi iskustvo najviše svjetske razine. Najveći krovni infinity bazen u Europi, dugačak 105 metara, nudi impresivne poglede na Piranski zaljev i nezaboravne zalaske sunca. Na krovu se smjestio i fine dining restoran koji spaja internacionalnu i istarsku kuhinju, dok ljetna trattoria unosi opušteni talijanski šarm. Spa i wellness centar prostire se na više razina te uključuje unutarnji grijani bazen, pet sauna s panoramskim pogledom na more, luksuzne masažne tretmane i privatne spa apartmane za parove. Resort raspolaže i privatnom plažom, fitness centrom, dječjim bazenima i igralištima, a samo pet minuta udaljen je od najvećeg golf terena u Hrvatskoj s 18 rupa. Vlasnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su i 24-satna recepcija, konsijerž, električni buggy prijevoz unutar resorta, usluga parkiranja i sigurnost na najvišoj razini.
Lokacija
Savudrija, smještena na sjeverozapadnom rtu Istre, poznata je po svojoj tišini, netaknutoj prirodi i bogatoj povijesti. Najstariji svjetionik na Jadranu, čarobni vinogradi i maslinici te šarmantni srednjovjekovni gradići u neposrednoj blizini čine ovu lokaciju posebnom. Savudrija nudi kombinaciju mirnog mediteranskog okruženja i iznimne prometne povezanosti, Trst je udaljen 94 kilometra, Ljubljana 135, Venecija 202, Zagreb 275, a Beč 515 kilometara. Zahvaljujući blizini nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka, Petram Resort je lako dostupan klijentima iz cijele Europe, što dodatno povećava atraktivnost investicije.
OPIS APARTMANA
Apartman C-61 – 2. kat – stambena površina 83,30 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + kupaonica + wc) + balkon (14,00 m2 - pogled more) + vanjsko parking mjesto broj 176, obračunska neto površina 93,30 m2 = 815.080,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Apartmani u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju priliku da spojite luksuzni mediteranski život, osobno zadovoljstvo i stabilan prihod od najma, u najluksuznijem resortu na hrvatskoj obali.
listing.description_text_en:
In the northwest of Istria, in Savudrija, the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast and a unique project that combines contemporary architecture, top comfort, and investment security. This is a place where apartment ownership means much more than just real estate; it is an entry into a world of prestigious lifestyle, privacy, and luxurious vacation. Owners can enjoy all the amenities of a world-renowned resort while simultaneously generating stable income through a professionally organized rental program. Resort is designed as a destination for hedonists, families, and investors seeking uncompromising luxury.
Apartments
The main resort building houses 179 apartments of various types. All apartments have private terraces with views of the sea or Mediterranean greenery, and the interiors are decorated in a contemporary style emphasizing elegance and natural materials. Each unit is equipped with a modern kitchen, bathrooms with underfloor heating, a washer and dryer, a smart TV system, a safety deposit box, and high-speed wireless internet. Special attention is given to details that create a feeling of home and luxury hotel combined, from high-quality materials to personalized services such as children's equipment or pet amenities upon request.
Rental and Investment
Ownership is a smart investment. The entire complex offers professional property management and a rental program that takes care of bookings, guest check-ins, cleaning, maintenance, and marketing. This allows owners completely worry-free management of their apartments. Thanks to the prestigious location and extremely high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, the apartments generate annual returns of 5 to 7 percent, with the flexibility for owners to enjoy their own apartment during selected periods. In this way, the property becomes both a personal pleasure and a source of stable income.
Resort and Lifestyle
Living at Resort offers an experience of the highest global standards. The largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, 105 meters long, provides impressive views of the Piran Bay and unforgettable sunsets. On the roof is also a fine dining restaurant combining international and Istrian cuisine, while the summer trattoria brings a relaxed Italian charm. The spa and wellness center spans multiple levels and includes an indoor heated pool, five saunas with panoramic sea views, luxurious massage treatments, and private spa apartments for couples. The resort also features a private beach, fitness center, children's pools and playgrounds, and is only five minutes away from the largest golf course in Croatia with 18 holes. Owners and guests have access to 24-hour reception, concierge service, electric buggy transport within the resort, parking service, and top-level security.
Location
Savudrija, located on the northwestern tip of Istria, is known for its tranquility, unspoiled nature, and rich history. The oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic, magical vineyards and olive groves, and charming medieval towns in the immediate vicinity make this location special. Savudrija offers a combination of peaceful Mediterranean surroundings and excellent transport connections; Trieste is 94 kilometers away, Ljubljana 135, Venice 202, Zagreb 275, and Vienna 515 kilometers. Thanks to the proximity of several international airports,
APARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Apartment C-61 – 2nd floor – living area 83.30 m2 (2 bedrooms + bathroom + WC) + balcony (14.00 m2 - sea view) + outdoor parking space number 176, calculated net area 93.30 m2 = 815,080.00 EUR (including furniture)
Apartments represent an opportunity to combine luxurious Mediterranean living, personal satisfaction, and stable rental income in the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast.

listing.title_text: Ekskluzivna vila u Istri - spoj luksuza i investicije
listing.title_text_en: Exclusive villa in Istria - a combination of luxury and investment
listing.description_text:
Na prestižnoj lokaciji u neposrednoj blizini mora, u Istri, smješten je Petram Resort & Residences, projekt koji postavlja nove standarde luksuza na Jadranu. Resort nudi 55 ekskluzivnih vila zamišljene kao privatne baze za one koji traže apsolutnu udobnost, sigurnost i prestiž. Svaka vila pruža spoj vrhunskog dizajna, suvremenih tehnologija i jedinstvene pozicije, dok vlasnicima omogućuje i atraktivnu investicijsku priliku kroz profesionalno vođen program najma.
Kupnjom vile u Petram Resortu ne ulažete samo u nekretninu, već u životni stil koji kombinira privatnost, luksuz i potpuni užitak u svim sadržajima jednog od najekskluzivnijih resorta u Hrvatskoj.
Vile
Ponuda uključuje različite tipove vila, površine od 220 do 380 m2 raspoređenih tako da osiguraju maksimalnu privatnost i spektakularne poglede. Dvanaest vila ima vlastite infinity bazene na krovnim terasama, dok ostale nude prostrane privatne vrtove i terase savršene za odmor i druženje. Svaka vila pažljivo je integrirana u mediteranski ambijent, s naglaskom na prirodne materijale, prostrane staklene stijene i otvorene tlocrte koji spajaju interijer s eksterijerom.
Unutrašnjost vila dizajnirana je da pruži apsolutnu udobnost. Prostrane spavaće sobe, više luksuzno opremljenih kupaonica, elegantni dnevni boravci i potpuno opremljene kuhinje čine ih idealnim mjestom i za privatni boravak i za luksuzni turistički najam.
Najam i investicija
Vile u Petram Resortu kombiniraju prestiž vlasništva i sigurnost investicije. Profesionalni tim resorta brine o kompletnom upravljanju, od marketinga i rezervacija, do čišćenja, održavanja i prijave gostiju. Vlasnicima to donosi potpuno bezbrižno iskustvo i stabilne godišnje prihode. S obzirom na rastuću potražnju za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, očekivani prinosi su izuzetno atraktivni, dok sama nekretnina dugoročno čuva i povećava vrijednost. Vlasnici pritom imaju fleksibilnost korištenja vile za osobni odmor kad god to požele.
Resort i lifestyle
Kupnja vile u Petram Resort & Residences znači pristup svim sadržajima koji čine ovaj kompleks jedinstvenim. Vlasnici uživaju u najvećem krovnom infinity bazenu u Europi, ekskluzivnom spa i wellness centru s unutarnjim bazenima i panoramskim saunama, privatnoj plaži, rooftop restoranima, talijanskoj trattoriji i brojnim gourmet iskustvima. Ljubitelji sporta imaju na raspolaganju teniske terene, teretanu s pogledom na more i golf teren s 18 rupa udaljen svega nekoliko minuta. Resort pruža i vrhunsku sigurnost s 24/7 zaštitom, uslugom konsijerža, valet parkingom, transferima prema zračnim lukama i prijevozom unutar kompleksa električnim vozilima.
O Savudriji
Savudrija, najsjevernija točka Istre, mjesto je gdje priroda, povijest i moderni luksuz stvaraju jedinstvenu harmoniju. Ovdje se nalaze vinogradi, maslinici i srednjovjekovni istarski gradići, a regija je poznata i po svojoj vrhunskoj gastronomiji. Savudrija je idealna za miran i profinjen odmor, ali i savršeno povezana s Europom: Venecija, Ljubljana, Zagreb i Beč udaljeni su samo nekoliko sati vožnje, dok se u blizini nalazi i nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka. Upravo ta kombinacija autentičnog istarskog šarma i izvanredne dostupnosti čini Petram Resort savršenim izborom za vlasnike vila i njihove goste.
OPIS VILE
VILA TIP1 – suteren, prizemlje i kat – stambena površina 190,27 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + 2 kupaonice + wc + studio apartman + igraonica + ostava) + balkon (25 m2) + terasa (45 m2) + vrt (198 m2) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 282,79 m2 = 1.746.375,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Vile u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju rijetku priliku za vlasništvo na najprestižnijoj lokaciji u Istri. To je spoj privatnosti, luksuza i pametnog investiranja, koji istovremeno pruža savršen prostor za visoku kvalitetu života i pouzdani izvor prihoda.
listing.description_text_en:
In a prestigious location in the immediate vicinity of the sea, in Istria, is situated, a project that sets new standards of luxury on the Adriatic. The resort offers 55 exclusive villas designed as private bases for those seeking absolute comfort, security, and prestige. Each villa provides a combination of top-level design, modern technologies, and a unique position, while also offering owners an attractive investment opportunity through a professionally managed rental program.
By purchasing a villa, you are investing not only in real estate but also in a lifestyle that combines privacy, luxury, and complete enjoyment of all the amenities of one of the most exclusive resorts in Croatia.
Villas
The offer includes various types of villas, with areas ranging from 220 to 380 m2, arranged to ensure maximum privacy and spectacular views. Twelve villas have their own infinity pools on rooftop terraces, while the others offer spacious private gardens and terraces perfect for relaxation and socializing. Each villa is carefully integrated into the Mediterranean environment, emphasizing natural materials, large glass walls, and open floor plans that connect the interior with the exterior.
The interiors of the villas are designed to provide absolute comfort. Spacious bedrooms, multiple luxuriously equipped bathrooms, elegant living rooms, and fully equipped kitchens make them ideal both for private residence and luxury tourist rental.
Rental and Investment
The villas in Resort combine the prestige of ownership with investment security. The resort’s professional team takes care of complete management, from marketing and bookings to cleaning, maintenance, and guest registration. This provides owners with a completely worry-free experience and stable annual income. Given the growing demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, expected returns are highly attractive, while the property itself preserves and increases its value in the long term. Owners also have the flexibility to use the villa for personal vacations whenever they wish.
Resort and Lifestyle
Purchasing a villa in Resort means access to all the amenities that make this complex unique. Owners enjoy the largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, an exclusive spa and wellness center with indoor pools and panoramic saunas, a private beach, rooftop restaurants, an Italian trattoria, and numerous gourmet experiences. Sports enthusiasts have access to tennis courts, a gym with sea views, and an 18-hole golf course just minutes away. The resort also provides top-level security with 24/7 protection, concierge service, valet parking, airport transfers, and transportation within the complex by electric vehicles.
About Savudrija
Savudrija, the northernmost point of Istria, is a place where nature, history, and modern luxury create a unique harmony. Here you will find vineyards, olive groves, and medieval Istrian towns, and the region is also known for its top gastronomy. Savudrija is ideal for a peaceful and refined vacation but also perfectly connected to Europe: Venice, Ljubljana, Zagreb, and Vienna are only a few hours’ drive away, and several international airports are nearby. This combination of authentic Istrian charm and excellent accessibility makes Petram Resort a perfect choice for villa owners and their guests.
VILLA DESCRIPTION
VILLA TYPE 1 – basement, ground floor, and first floor – living area 190.27 m2 (2 bedrooms + 2 bathrooms + WC + studio apartment + playroom + storage) + balcony (25 m2) + terrace (45 m2) + garden (198 m2) + outdoor parking space, calculated net area 282.79 m2 = 1,746,375.00 EUR (including furniture)
Villas represent a rare opportunity for ownership in the most prestigious location in Istria. It is a combination of privacy, luxury, and smart investing, which simultaneously provides a perfect space for a high quality of life and a reliable source of income.
