Vlasnicima to donosi potpuno bezbrižno iskustvo i stabilne godišnje prihode. S obzirom na rastuću potražnju za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, očekivani prinosi su izuzetno atraktivni, dok sama nekretnina dugoročno čuva i povećava vrijednost. Vlasnici pritom imaju fleksibilnost korištenja vile za osobni odmor kad god to požele.
Resort i lifestyle
Kupnja vile u Petram Resort & Residences znači pristup svim sadržajima koji čine ovaj kompleks jedinstvenim. Vlasnici uživaju u najvećem krovnom infinity bazenu u Europi, ekskluzivnom spa i wellness centru s unutarnjim bazenima i panoramskim saunama, privatnoj plaži, rooftop restoranima, talijanskoj trattoriji i brojnim gourmet iskustvima. Ljubitelji sporta imaju na raspolaganju teniske terene, teretanu s pogledom na more i golf teren s 18 rupa udaljen svega nekoliko minuta. Resort pruža i vrhunsku sigurnost s 24/7 zaštitom, uslugom konsijerža, valet parkingom, transferima prema zračnim lukama i prijevozom unutar kompleksa električnim vozilima.
O Savudriji
Savudrija, najsjevernija točka Istre, mjesto je gdje priroda, povijest i moderni luksuz stvaraju jedinstvenu harmoniju. Ovdje se nalaze vinogradi, maslinici i srednjovjekovni istarski gradići, a regija je poznata i po svojoj vrhunskoj gastronomiji. Savudrija je idealna za miran i profinjen odmor, ali i savršeno povezana s Europom: Venecija, Ljubljana, Zagreb i Beč udaljeni su samo nekoliko sati vožnje, dok se u blizini nalazi i nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka. Upravo ta kombinacija autentičnog istarskog šarma i izvanredne dostupnosti čini Petram Resort savršenim izborom za vlasnike vila i njihove goste.
OPIS VILE
VILA TIP3 – podrum, suteren, prizemlje, 1. kat i 2. kat – stambena površina 401,77 m2 (4 spavaće sobe + 5 kupaonica + 2 wc + studio apartman + igraonica + ostava + konoba + vinski podrum) + infinity bazen na krovu (29 m2) + balkon (26 m2) + terasa (49 m2) + garaža za dva automobila + vrt (215 m2) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 489,75 m2 = 2.929.700,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Vile u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju rijetku priliku za vlasništvo na najprestižnijoj lokaciji u Istri. To je spoj privatnosti, luksuza i pametnog investiranja, koji istovremeno pruža savršen prostor za visoku kvalitetu života i pouzdani izvor prihoda.
listing.description_text_en:
Located in a prestigious location in close proximity to the sea, in Istria, is a project that sets new standards of luxury on the Adriatic. The resort offers 55 exclusive villas designed as private bases for those seeking absolute comfort, security, and prestige. Each villa provides a blend of top-tier design, modern technologies, and a unique position, while also offering owners an attractive investment opportunity through a professionally managed rental program.
By purchasing a villa, you are investing not only in real estate but in a lifestyle that combines privacy, luxury, and complete enjoyment of all the amenities of one of the most exclusive resorts in Croatia.
Villas
The offer includes various types of villas, ranging in size from 220 to 380 m2, arranged to ensure maximum privacy and spectacular views. Twelve villas feature private infinity pools on rooftop terraces, while the others offer spacious private gardens and terraces perfect for relaxation and socializing. Each villa is carefully integrated into the Mediterranean environment, emphasizing natural materials, large glass walls, and open floor plans that connect the interior with the exterior.
The interior of the villas is designed to provide absolute comfort. Spacious bedrooms, multiple luxuriously equipped bathrooms, elegant living rooms, and fully equipped kitchens make them ideal both for private residence and luxury tourist rental.
Rental and Investment
The villas in Resort combine ownership prestige with investment security. The resort’s professional team takes care of complete management, from marketing and bookings to cleaning, maintenance, and guest registration. This provides owners with a completely worry-free experience and stable annual income. Given the growing demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, expected returns are highly attractive, while the property itself preserves and increases its value in the long term. Owners also have the flexibility to use the villa for personal vacations whenever they wish.
Resort and Lifestyle
Purchasing a villa means access to all the amenities that make this complex unique. Owners enjoy the largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, an exclusive spa and wellness center with indoor pools and panoramic saunas, a private beach, rooftop restaurants, an Italian trattoria, and numerous gourmet experiences. Sports enthusiasts have access to tennis courts, a gym with sea views, and an 18-hole golf course just minutes away. The resort also provides top-level security with 24/7 protection, concierge service, valet parking, airport transfers, and electric vehicle transportation within the complex.
About Savudrija
Savudrija, the northernmost point of Istria, is a place where nature, history, and modern luxury create a unique harmony. Here you will find vineyards, olive groves, and medieval Istrian towns, and the region is also known for its exceptional gastronomy. Savudrija is ideal for a peaceful and refined vacation but is also perfectly connected to Europe: Venice, Ljubljana, Zagreb, and Vienna are only a few hours’ drive away, and several international airports are nearby. This combination of authentic Istrian charm and excellent accessibility makes Petram Resort the perfect choice for villa owners and their guests.
VILLA DESCRIPTION
VILLA TYPE 3 – basement, lower ground floor, ground floor, 1st floor, and 2nd floor – living area 401.77 m2 (4 bedrooms + 5 bathrooms + 2 WCs + studio apartment + playroom + storage + tavern + wine cellar) + rooftop infinity pool (29 m2) + balcony (26 m2) + terrace (49 m2) + garage for two cars + garden (215 m2) + outdoor parking space, calculated net area 489.75 m2 = 2,929,700.00 EUR (including furnishings)
The villas in Resort represent a rare opportunity for ownership in the most prestigious location in Istria. It is a combination of privacy, luxury, and smart investing, which simultaneously provides a perfect space for a high quality of life and a reliable source of income.

listing.title_text: Stan (89 m2) - kvaliteta života u Istri
listing.title_text_en: Apartment (89 m2) – quality of life in Istria
listing.description_text:
sklopu Petram Resort & Residences nalaze se tri elegantne stambene zgrade s ukupno osamnaest stanova za one koji žele spoj mirnog života i svih pogodnosti vrhunskog resorta. Stanovi predstavljaju jedinstvenu priliku za život u privatnom okruženju uz neposredan pristup sadržajima svjetske klase. Ovo je rješenje za one koji traže luksuzan apartman na moru, bilo za stalni boravak ili kao destinaciju za odmor, uz dodatnu prednost stabilne investicije kroz model najma.
Stanovi
Tri niske stambene zgrade smještene u zelenilu imaju šest stanova po objektu, čime se osigurava mir i privatnost. Stanovi su pažljivo projektirani, od dvosobnih do prostranih dvoetažnih jedinica. Svaki stan ima vlastitu terasu ili loggiu, suvremeno uređene interijere i maksimalnu funkcionalnost. Uređenje interijera temelji se na kombinaciji modernog dizajna i mediteranskog duha, s prostranim dnevnim boravcima, prirodnim svjetlom i vrhunskim materijalima.
Najam i investicija
Stanovi u Petram Resortu nude mogućnost sudjelovanja u profesionalnom programu upravljanja i najma. Vlasnici mogu prepustiti kompletnu brigu o svojoj nekretnini iskusnom timu resorta i pritom ostvarivati atraktivne godišnje prihode. S obzirom na visoku potražnju za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, očekivani prinosi kreću se u rasponu od 5 do 7 posto, a istovremeno vlasnici zadržavaju fleksibilnost da koriste stan u razdobljima koja im odgovaraju. Upravo ova kombinacija sigurnog prihoda i osobne koristi čini stanove odličnom investicijom za dugoročno očuvanje i rast vrijednosti.
Resort i lifestyle
Stanovi imaju prednost intimnog stanovanja, ali i potpunu uključenost u život Petram Resorta. Vlasnici mogu uživati u istim pogodnostima kao i gosti apartmana i vila, od najvećeg krovnog infinity bazena u Europi, do privatne plaže, wellness i spa centra, vrhunskih restorana i sportskih sadržaja. Obitelji s djecom cijene sigurnost zatvorene zajednice, obiteljske sadržaje i bogate programe za djecu, dok ljubitelji aktivnog života uživaju u golfu, tenisu i biciklističkim rutama kroz istarsko zelenilo.
O Savudriji
Savudrija, tiho ribarsko mjesto na krajnjem sjeveru Istre, posljednjih godina je izraslo u prestižnu destinaciju. Osim što je poznata po najstarijem svjetioniku na Jadranu i čuvenim zalascima sunca, regija nudi bogatu gastronomsku i vinsku scenu, maslinova ulja svjetske klase i brojne kulturne manifestacije tijekom cijele godine. Blizina gradova poput Trsta, Ljubljane i Venecije, kao i odlična prometna povezanost s cijelom Europom, čine ovu lokaciju savršenom za vlasnike koji žele uživati u autentičnom mediteranskom životu, a istovremeno zadržati jednostavan pristup svojim domovima.
OPIS STANA
Stan A1-S2 – prizemlje – stambena površina 74,76 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + 2 kupaonice + wc) + terasa (20 m2) + vrt (75,85 m2) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 89,84 = 452.793,00 EUR
Stanovi u Petram Resort & Residences pružaju rijetku kombinaciju luksuznog stanovanja, privatnosti i pristup jednom od najprestižnijih resorta u regiji. Ovo je investicija koja nudi sigurnost, stabilan prihod i visoku kvalitetu života.
listing.description_text_en:
There are three elegant residential buildings with a total of eighteen apartments for those who want to combine peaceful living with all the amenities of a top-class resort. The apartments represent a unique opportunity to live in a private environment with direct access to world-class facilities. This is a solution for those seeking a luxury seaside apartment, either for permanent residence or as a holiday destination, with the added advantage of a stable investment through a rental model.
Apartments
Three low-rise residential buildings set in greenery each have six apartments, ensuring peace and privacy. The apartments are carefully designed, ranging from two-bedroom units to spacious duplexes. Each apartment has its own terrace or loggia, modern interiors, and maximum functionality. The interior design is based on a combination of modern style and Mediterranean spirit, with spacious living rooms, natural light, and premium materials.
Rental and Investment
The apartments in offer the possibility to participate in a professional management and rental program. Owners can entrust the complete care of their property to the experienced resort team and earn attractive annual income. Given the high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, expected returns range from 5 to 7 percent, while owners retain the flexibility to use the apartment during periods that suit them. This combination of secure income and personal use makes the apartments an excellent investment for long-term preservation and growth of value.
Resort and Lifestyle
The apartments offer the advantage of intimate living while being fully integrated into the life of Resort. Owners can enjoy the same benefits as guests of the apartments and villas, from the largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe to a private beach, wellness and spa center, top restaurants, and sports facilities. Families with children appreciate the safety of the gated community, family amenities, and rich children’s programs, while active lifestyle enthusiasts enjoy golf, tennis, and cycling routes through Istrian greenery.
About Savudrija
Savudrija, a quiet fishing village at the northern tip of Istria, has grown in recent years into a prestigious destination. Besides being known for the oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic and famous sunsets, the region offers a rich gastronomic and wine scene, world-class olive oils, and numerous cultural events throughout the year. The proximity to cities like Trieste, Ljubljana, and Venice, as well as excellent transport connections to all of Europe, make this location perfect for owners who want to enjoy authentic Mediterranean living while maintaining easy access to their homes.
APARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Apartment A1-S2 – ground floor – living area 74.76 m2 (2 bedrooms + 2 bathrooms + WC) + terrace (20 m2) + garden (75.85 m2) + outdoor parking space, calculated net area 89.84 = 452,793.00 EUR
The apartments provide a rare combination of luxury living, privacy, and access to one of the most prestigious resorts in the region. This is an investment offering security, stable income, and a high quality of life.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 89 m² (77 m² + 12 m² terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2
Namješten dvosoban stan u zgradi Alba, dio novog mješovitog kompleksa Boka Place u Portu Montenegru. Stan ima površinu od 89 m² i sastoji se od dnevnog boravka otvorenog plana sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, dvije spavaće sobe, kupatila, vešeraja i prostrane terase od 12 m².
Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten.
Boka Place je novi urbani kvart unutar Porto Montenegra, komercijalni i stambeni centar sa prodavnicama, kafićima, kinom, hotelom i wellness centrom, zelenim otvorenim prostorima, galerijama, svjetskim modnim brendovima i privatnim rezidencijama. Rezidencije su inteligentno dizajnirane da ponude i funkcionalnost i ljepotu.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 89 m2 (77 m2 + 12 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Furnished, Two-bedroom apartment in the Alba building, part of the new mixed complex Boka Place in Porto Montenegro. The apartment has an area of 89 m2 and consists of an open-plan living room with a dining room and kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom, a laundry, and a spacious terrace of 12 m2.
The apartment is for sale fully furnished.
Boka Place is a new urban district within Porto Montenegro, a commercial and residential center with shops, cafes, a cinema, a hotel and wellness center, green open spaces, galleries, world fashion brands, and private residences. The residences are intelligently designed to offer both function and beauty.

Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Dobro proporcioniran dvosoban stan na obali mora u zgradi Aqua, Porto Montenegro.
Stan ima 140 m2 i sastoji se od velikog otvorenog dnevnog boravka sa kaminom, trpezarijom i kuhinjom, dvije spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, toaleta za goste i prostrane terase od 27 m2 sa panoramskim pogledom na more.

Zgrada Aqua je dio Regent Pool Cluba, pa vlasnici stanova koriste usluge hotela Regent 5* – bazene, spa, teretanu itd.

Area: 140 m2 (113 m2 + 27 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Well-proportioned, waterfront two-bedroom apartment in the Aqua building, Porto Montenegro.
The apartment occupies an area of 140 m2 and consists of a large open-plan living room with a fireplace, dining area and kitchen, two en suite bedrooms, guest toilet, and a spacious terrace of 27 m2 with panoramic sea views.
The price includes a full furniture package up to hotel standards.
The Aqua building is part of the Regent Pool Club, so apartment owners can use the services of the 5 * Regent Hotel, including swimming pools, spa, gym, etc.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marine resort with exclusive residences, boutiques, hotels, etc.

listing.title_text: Apartman sa 3 spavaće sobe i uslugama u zgradi Baia
listing.description_text:
Površina stana: 193 m2 (124 m2 + terasa 69 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 3
Garaža
Ekskluzivan, potpuno opremljen trosoban stan od 193 m2 u zgradi Baia, Regent Pool Club Residences. Stan se sastoji od otvorenog dnevnog boravka s kuhinjom i trpezarijom, tri spavaće sobe s kupatilima i prostrane terase s direktnim pristupom bazenu.
Bazirane na modelu „hotelskog kondominija“, ove luksuzne rezidencije na prodaju, s opcionim programom najma, imaju direktan pristup opsežnim uslugama i sadržajima petozvjezdičnog hotela Regent i menadžerski tim koji se može brinuti o održavanju i administraciji najma na zahtjev vlasnika.
Zgrada Baia je dio Regent Pool Cluba, tako da vlasnici apartmana mogu koristiti usluge hotela Regent 5*, uključujući bazene, spa centar, teretanu itd.
Porto Montenegro je svjetski poznato odmaralište sa marinom, ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, buticima, hotelima itd.

Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3
Garage
Exclusive, fully equipped three-bedroom apartment of 193 m2 in the Baia building, Regent Pool Club Residences. The apartment consists of an open-plan living room with kitchen and dining room, three bedrooms with bathrooms, and a spacious terrace with direct access to the pool.
Based on the ‘hotel condominium’ model, these luxury residences for sale, with an optional rental program, have direct access to the extensive services and facilities of the five-star Regent Hotel and a management team that can take care of the maintenance and administration of the lease upon owner’s request.
The Baia building is part of the Regent Pool Club, so apartment owners can use the services of the Regent 5 * hotel, including pools, spa, gym, etc.

Površina: 491 m2 (256 m2 + terasa 89 m2 + krovna terasa 146 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 3

Portonovi je ultra-premium rizortna lifestyle destinacija koja obuhvata 218 rezidencijalnih jedinica svjetske klase i vrhunsku marinu za mega jahte, smještenu na najužem dijelu ulaza u Boku Kotorsku.
Portonovi ima odličan položaj između planina i mora, s ambijentalnim pogledom na netaknutu jadransku obalu. Portonovi is an ultra-premium resort lifestyle destination that includes 218 world-class housing units and a top marina for mega yachts, at the narrowest part of the entrance to the Bay of Kotor.
Portonovi has an excellent position between the mountains and the sea, with an ambient view of the untouched Adriatic coast. Portonovi includes Europe’s first One & Only resort, luxury residences, Henri Chenot destination health and Wellness Spa, a world-class marina serving mega yachts (with fuel tax rebates of up to 40%), the region’s largest sandy beach with a luxury beach club.

Portonovi includes Europe’s first One&Only resort, luxury residences, Henri Chenot destination health and Wellness Spa, a world-class marina serving mega yachts, and the region’s largest sandy beach with a luxury beach club.
Other features include onshore retail outlets, coffee bars, and restaurants.

Struktura vile:
Prizemlje: prostran dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, toalet za goste, vešernica, ostava, prostorija za otpad, tehnička prostorija i dva studija za osoblje, svaki sa spavaćom sobom, kupatilom i čajnom kuhinjom. Sa terase dnevnog boravka izlazi se direktno na spoljni bazen i plažu.
Prvi sprat: tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, svaka sa privatnom terasom, i prostrana krovna terasa za odmor i opuštanje.
Ova zadivljujuća vila uz more ima:
• tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• privatni bazen
• privatna pješčana plaža
• privatni mol
• privatna bašta sa terasom za obroke na otvorenom
• dvije jednokrevetne sobe za osoblje sa sopstvenim kupatilima i čajnom kuhinjom
• posvećena usluga batlera
Cijena vile uključuje luksuzan namještaj po standardima One&Only; budući vlasnici moći će i da uključe vilu u program jedinica kojima upravlja One&Only i izdaju je preko sistema rezervacija One&Only. Program izdavanja je veoma fleksibilan, bez obaveznih termina korišćenja i sličnih ograničenja, a vlasništvo je puno.
One&Only Portonovi smješten je na ulazu u Boku, mjesto svjetske baštine UNESCO-a poznato po izuzetnoj prirodnoj ljepoti, bogatoj lokalnoj kulturi i istorijski važnoj venecijanskoj arhitekturi, čiji dio potiče još iz 9. vijeka.
Portonovi Montenegro je najekskluzivnija rizort destinacija na Jadranu, sa 290 nekretnina svjetske klase i najsavremenijom marinom za mega jahte, na najužem dijelu ulaza u Bokokotorski zaliv. Portonovi ima izuzetan položaj između planine i mora, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na netaknutu jadransku obalu. Obuhvata prvi One&Only rizort u Evropi, luksuzne rezidencije, medicinski i velnes spa Henri Chenot, marinu svjetske klase za mega jahte koja radi cijele godine (sa poreskim olakšicama na gorivo do 40%) i najveću pješčanu plažu u regionu sa luksuznim beach klubom. Tu su i prodavnice, kafići i restorani uz obalu.

listing.title_text: Jedinstven penthaus Elena sa sedam spavaćih soba, Porto Montenegro
listing.description_text:
Stambena površina: 1003,26 m2 (475,09 m2 + 170,92 m2 terase + 357,25 m2 krovne terase)
Spavaće sobe: 7
Bathrooms: 7 + 2
Garage: 4
Storage units: 3
Swimming pools: 2
Ekskluzivan, jedinstven penthaus na „pola sprata“ u Elena Residences, Porto Montenegro, nastao spajanjem dva susjedna penthausa u jednu izuzetnu rezidenciju koju odlikuju veličina, privatnost i arhitektonska upečatljivost.
Riječ je o privatnoj rezidenciji ukupne površine 1003,26 m2 sa 7 spavaćih soba – rijetkoj ekskluzivnoj nekretnini u jednoj od najprestižnijih zgrada marine Porto Montenegro.
Rezidencija ima dva prostrana dnevna boravka sa trpezarijama i kuhinjama, sedam spavaćih soba sa sopstvenim kupatilima, toalete za goste i više velikih terasa sa spektakularnim pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv, Lovćen, Tivat i marinu Porto Montenegro. Raspored omogućava fleksibilno korišćenje, uz punu funkcionalnu nezavisnost dva prvobitna penthausa.
Svaki penthaus zadržava sopstveni privatni ulaz sa posebnim liftom, što dodatno pojačava privatnost i ekskluzivnost. Na krovu su dvije privatne terase sa dva „infinity“ bazena samo za vlasnike, dvije potpuno opremljene spoljne kuhinje i dvije zone sa kaminom na drva – jedinstven prostor za život i druženje napolju.
Cijena uključuje ukupno četiri garažna mjesta i tri ostave, što rezidenciji dodaje udobnost i praktičnost.
Elena Residences je jedna od najtraženijih zgrada u Porto Montenegru, poznata po savremenoj arhitekturi, visokom standardu života i snažnom investicionom potencijalu. Porto Montenegro, kao marina svjetske klase, nudi luksuzan način života sa vrhunskim rezidencijama, hotelima, restoranima i buticima.
Ova nekretnina je zaista jedinstvena ponuda na tržištu – rijedak primjer privatne rezidencije na pola sprata ove veličine, sa 7 spavaćih soba i dvostrukim sadržajima na krovu. Vrijednost joj dodatno podižu panoramski pogled od 270 stepeni i lokacija u potpuno završenom dijelu master plana, bez buduće gradnje koja bi mogla uticati na pogled ili okruženje.
listing.description_text_en:

An exclusive unique “half-floor” penthouse within Elena Residences, Porto Montenegro, created by merging two adjacent penthouse apartments into a single, exceptional residence defined by scale, privacy, and architectural presence.
The property represents a private residence with a total area of 1003,26 m2 featuring 7 bedrooms and positioned as a rare trophy asset within one of the most prestigious buildings in Porto Montenegro marina.
The residence comprises two expansive living rooms with dining areas and kitchens, seven en-suite bedrooms, guest toilets, and multiple large terraces that open to spectacular views of the Bay of Kotor, Mount Lovćen, Tivat, and the Porto Montenegro marina. The layout is designed to allow flexible use while maintaining full functional independence of the two original penthouses.
Each penthouse retains its own private entrance via dedicated elevator access, further enhancing privacy and exclusivity. On the rooftop, there are two private rooftop terraces featuring two “infinity” swimming pools exclusively for the owners, as well as two fully equipped outdoor kitchens and two wood-burning fireplace zones, creating a unique outdoor living and entertainment environment.
The price includes a total of four garage spaces and three storage units, adding further comfort and practicality to the residence.
Elena Residences is one of the most sought-after buildings within Porto Montenegro, recognized for its contemporary architecture, high-end standard of living, and strong investment potential. Porto Montenegro, as a world-class marina, offers a luxury lifestyle concept with premium residences, hotels, restaurants, and boutiques.
This property is positioned as a truly unique offering on the market, a rare example of a private half-floor residence of this scale, featuring 7 bedrooms and dual rooftop amenities. Its value is further enhanced by 270-degree panoramic views and its location within a fully completed part of the masterplan, with no future construction that could impact the views or surroundings.

listing.description_text_en:
Area: 620 m2 (320 m2 internal + 300 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4 + 1
A unique penthouse apartment, with panoramic views, within the Porto Montenegro luxury residential complex and mega yacht marina. The apartment is a part of the Regent 5 * hotel with a total area of 620m2, (320 m2 of internal area and 300 m2 terrace).
This elegant and stylish property comprises of four bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a guest toilet, a large living room, a separate kitchen and dining room, and a large terrace facing the sea, surrounding the apartment from all sides, with a swimming pool.
The apartment is sold entirely furnished, in accordance with the Regent Hotel’s highest standards. It is perfectly positioned, on top of the eastern wing of the Regent Hotel, thus maximizing all benefits from the spectacular views of the sea and the entire Bay of Tivat from its spacious terrace. Also, the penthouse features direct access to two pools, a SPA center, a gym, and Regent Hotel premium restaurants.
Porto Montenegro is a vibrant luxury marina for mega yachts, situated on the waterfront, just minutes away from the Tivat city center with a long promenade and beautiful coastline. Besides the Regent Hotel and the boat moorings, Porto Montenegro also offers several signature restaurants, interesting café-bars, a shopping village, a grocery store, a luxury swimming pool, etc… all within several minutes of walk away from the apartment.
The complex is conveniently located between two main regional coastal airports – it is only 5km from the airport in Tivat and less than 40km from Dubrovnik airport.
Kotor, with UNESCO-protected Old Town, is 12km away.

listing.title_text: Stan Sirocco sa jednom spavaćom sobom
listing.description_text:
Površina: 77 m2 (61 m2 + terase 16 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 1
Kupatila: 1
Jednosoban stan sa pogledom na more kojim upravlja hotel SIRO 5*, u novoj četvrti Boka Place, Porto Montenegro.
Stan se sastoji od otvorenog dnevnog boravka sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, spavaće sobe, kupatila i prostrane terase sa pogledom na more.
Stan je potpuno namješten po standardima hotela SIRO 5*.
Garažno mjesto se može kupiti posebno, za dodatnih 40.000 EUR.
Boka Place je novi urbani kvart unutar Porto Montenegra, komercijalni i stambeni centar sa prodavnicama, kafićima, kinom, hotelom i wellness centrom, zelenim otvorenim prostorima, galerijama, svjetskim modnim brendovima i privatnim rezidencijama. Rezidencije su inteligentno dizajnirane da ponude i funkcionalnost i ljepotu.
Zgrada Sirocco je pod upravom hotela 5* SIRO, a vlasnici apartmana imaju mogućnost da ih izdaju putem hotelskog programa iznajmljivanja.
Hotel SIRO (One&Only Group) ima 144 upravljana stambena jedinica, krovni bazen dužine 20 metara, visokoperformansni studio, teretanu i druge sadržaje.
Boka Place se nalazi na uzvišenom terenu sa pogledom na marinu Porto Montenegro, svega nekoliko minuta od centralnog primorskog odmarališta i svih njegovih sadržaja.
listing.description_text_en:

Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 1
Sea-view one bedroom apartment managed by SIRO 5* hotel in new Boka Place neighborhood, Porto Montenegro.
The apartment consists of open-space living room with kitchen and dining area, one bedroom, one bathroom and a spacious terrace overlooking the sea.
The apartment is fully furnished by SIRO 5* hotel standards.
The garage space can be purchased separately for an additional 40,000. EUR
Boka Place is a new urban district within Porto Montenegro, a commercial and residential center with shops, cafes, a cinema, a hotel and wellness center, green open spaces, galleries, world fashion brands, and private residences. The residences are intelligently designed to offer both function and beauty.
Sirocco building is under the management of a 5*SIRO hotel, and apartment owners are able to rent the apartments through the hotel’s rental program.
Hotel SIRO (One& Only Group) has 144 managed residences, a 20-meter rooftop swimming pool, a high-performance studio, a gym, etc.
Boka Place is located on elevated ground overlooking the Porto Montenegro Marina, just a few minutes from the central waterfront resort and all its amenities.

Spektakularan objekat na obali, hotel Regent, centralni je dio marine Porto Montenegro.
Porto Montenegro je svjetski marina resort sa ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, prodavnicama, hotelima i drugim sadržajima. Svaka zgrada ima recepciju 24/7, upravljanje objektom, obezbjeđenje, zajednički bazen, teretanu i slično.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 43 m2
Bathrooms: 1
Studio apartment of 43 m2 in the Venezia building, Regent 5* hotel
It consists of two parts – a large living room with a sleeping area and access to the terrace with a view of the mountains and the promenade, and an entrance area with a kitchen, hallway, and a spacious bathroom with a bathtub and a shower.
The apartment is fully furnished and equipped according to hotel standards.
Spectacular waterfront property, the Regent Hotel is a central piece within the Porto Montenegro marina community.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina resort with exclusive residences, retail, hotels, etc. Each building has 24/7 reception, facility management, security, a shared swimming pool, a gym, etc.

listing.title_text: Studio apartman u novim rezidencijama Versa, Porto Montenegro
listing.title_text_en: Studio Apartment in New Versa Residences, Porto Montenegro
listing.description_text:
Površina: 58 m2 (47 m2 + terasa 5 m2 + 6 m2 u isključivom korišćenju)
Kupatila: 1
Garaža
Studio u potpuno novoj stambenoj zgradi Versa u Porto Montenegru.
Stan će imati otvoren dnevni prostor i trpezariju sa kuhinjom, kupatilo i terasu. Iz dnevnog boravka izlaziće se na terasu sa pogledom na Boka Place.
Stan će imati opremljenu kuhinju.
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Versa Residences je intimna kolekcija od 47 promišljeno osmišljenih stanova – studija, jednosobnih i dvosobnih – nastalih sa fokusom na ravnotežu, velnes i svakodnevnu udobnost. Stanari koriste prijatnu recepciju, bazen na podijumu sa zadivljujućim pogledom i dobro opremljenu teretanu na prvom spratu, a parking u kompleksu obezbjeđuje lak pristup i svakodnevnu udobnost.
Vero & Versa Residences su na pješačkoj udaljenosti od tržnog centra, međunarodne škole, medicinskog centra i raznih kafića i restorana internacionalne kuhinje, a more je udaljeno 50 m.
Pogodan plan plaćanja:
• Rezervacioni depozit: 10.000 €
• Predugovorni depozit: 10%, umanjen za rezervacioni depozit
• Prva rata: 30%, umanjena za predugovorni depozit
• Druga i treća rata, prema strukturi izgradnje: 25%
• Završna rata: 20% (kraj 2028. godine)
Cijena garažnog mjesta: 50.000 €
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 58 m2 (47 m2 + 5 m2 terrace + 6 m2 EUR area)
Bathrooms: 1
Garage
Studio apartment in Porto Montenegro brand new Versa residential building.
The apartment will consist of open space living and dining area with kitchen, one bathroom and a terrace. Living room will offer access to the terrace overlooking Boka Place.
Apartment will have an equipped kitchen.
The owners will have an option to choose fully bespoke furniture packages from Manor Interior Design, with fixed prices until June 2026.
Versa Residences is an intimate collection of 47 thoughtfully designed apartments, including studios, one- and two-bedroom homes, created with a focus on balance, wellness and everyday convenience. Residents can take advantage of an inviting reception area and a podium-level pool with stunning views and a well-equipped first-floor gym, while on-site parking ensures easy access and day-to-day comfort.
Vero & Versa Residences are located in walking distance to shopping mall, international school, medical center, various cafes and restaurants with international cuisine and distance to the sea is 50 m.
Convenient payment plan:
• Reservation deposit: 10,000 eur
• Pre-contract deposit: 10% reduced by Reservation deposit
• First installment: 30% reduced by Pre-Contract deposit
• Second and third installment, according to the development structure: 25%
• Final installment: 20% (end of 2028)
Price for garage space is 50,000 eur.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 64 m2
Spavaćih soba: 1
Kupatila: 1
Jednosobni, namješteni apartman u zgradi Tara sa pogledom na more i direktnim pristupom bazenu.
Apartman zauzima površinu od 64 m2 i sastoji se od dnevnog boravka sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, spavaće sobe sa kupatilom, te terase sa direktnim pristupom bazenu i pogledom na more.
Vlasnicima je na raspolaganju usluga konsijerža i obezbjeđenje 24/7, kao i korišćenje otvorenog bazena i teretane.
Zgrada Tara je jedna od najpoželjnijih u Porto Montenegru zbog prekrasnog interijera, prostranog zajedničkog bazena, zelenila i stila gradnje.
Porto Montenegro je marina svjetske klase za superjahte, sa prekrasnom kolekcijom stambenih objekata, maloprodajnim objektima i velikim brojem restorana.
Najbliži aerodrom je Aerodrom Tivat, udaljen 4 km od Porto Montenegra. Aerodrom Dubrovnik udaljen je 48 km, a Aerodrom Podgorica 88 km.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 64 m2
Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 1
A one-bedroom, furnished apartment in Tara building with sea view and direct access to a swimming pool.
The apartment occupies an area of 64 m2 and consists of a living room with a dining room and a kitchen, bedroom with bathroom, and a terrace with direct access to the swimming pool and a view of the sea.
Owners are offered concierge service and 24/7 security, as well as the use of outdoor swimming pool and gym.
Tara building is one of the most desirable ones within Porto Montenegro due to the beautiful interiors, spacious shared pool, greenery and style of construction.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina for super-yachts, with beautiful residential collection, retail, large number of restaurants.
The nearest airport is Tivat Airport, 4 km from Porto Montenegro. Dubrovnik Airport is 48 km away, Podgorica Airport is 88 km away.

listing.title_text: Savremen stan sa četiri spavaće sobe, Tara
listing.description_text:
Površina: 240 m2
Spavaće sobe: 4
Kupatila: 4 + 1
Garaža
Namješten
Skladno raspoređen stan sa 4 spavaće sobe od 240 m2 u zgradi Tara.
Stan se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka sa izlazom na veliku terasu sa zadivljujućim pogledom na more, kuhinje i trpezarije, 4 spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, toaleta za goste i vešernice.
Potpuno je namješten i spreman za useljenje. Jedno garažno mjesto je uračunato u cijenu.
Zgrada Tara je iza Venecijanskog trga, u neposrednoj blizini hotela Regent 5*.
Porto Montenegro je marina svjetske klase sa ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, prodavnicama, restoranima itd.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 240 m2
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4 + 1
Garage space
Furnished
Well-proportioned 4-bedroom apartment of 240 m2 in Tara building.
The apartment consists of a spacious living room with access to a big terrace with stunning sea views, a kitchen and a dining area, 4 en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet, and a laundry room.
It is fully furnished and ready to move in. One garage space is included in the price.
Tara building is located in the back of Venice square, in the immediate vicinity of Regent 5* hotel.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina resort with exclusive residences, retail, restaurants etc.

listing.title_text: Stan Teuta sa jednom spavaćom sobom, za izdavanje
listing.description_text:
Površina: 119 m2
Spavaćih soba: 1
Kupatila: 1+1
Garažno mjesto
Ekskluzivan, luksuzno namješten jednosoban stan u zgradi Teuta.
Stan se sastoji od prostranog otvorenog dnevnog boravka sa trpezarijom, kuhinje, prostrane terase sa otvorenim pogledom na more i marinu, spavaće sobe sa kupatilom i garderoberom, toaleta za goste i ostave.
KARAKTERISTIKE
• Pogled na more i planine
• 24-satno obezbjeđenje i recepcija
• Zajednički bazen i teretana u zgradi
• U blizini svi sadržaji naselja (bankomat, apoteka, frizer, dnevni spa, prodavnica)
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 119 m2
Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 1+1
Garage place
Exclusive, luxuriously furnished one-room apartment in the Teuta building.
The apartment consists of a spacious open-plan living room with a dining room, a kitchen, a spacious terrace with an open view of the sea and the marina, a bedroom with a bathroom and wardrobe, a guest toilet, and a storage room.
FEATURES
• Sea and mountain view
• 24-hour security and reception
• Communal pool and gymnasium in the building
• Nearby all Village amenities (ATM, pharmacy, hairdresser, day spa, grocery shop)

listing.description_text:
Total area: 397 sqm
Internal area: 277 sqm
Ext. area: 120 sqm
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4+toilet
Parking, furniture
Exclusive four-bedroom apartment of 397sq m, on the fourth floor of Teuta building, in Porto Montenegro super-yacht marina and residential complex.
The apartment has perfect position, with the main terrace of 120 sq m, opening directly towards the marina and overlooking the sea and the entire bay of Tivat.
FEATURES
• Sea and mountain view
• Fully furnished with modern interiors
• 24-hour security and reception
• Communal pool and gymnasium in the building
• Nearby all Village amenities (ATM, pharmacy, hair dresser, day spa, grocery shop)
Designed for nautical living, the residences at Porto Montenegro make the most of the warm, Mediterranean climate.
Open, airy interiors feature high ceilings, large windows and expansive terraces, while the architecture reflects the
historic influences of the Venetian Republic. Internationally acclaimed designer Tino Zervudachi has planned each residence in Porto Montenegro, individually sourcing materials both locally and from around the world.
Rooms are designed with a palette of soft colours, complemented by a mix of stone and hardwood. Lighting, sockets, switch plates and control panels are discreetly incorporated while integrated bookcases and
cupboards in natural timbers or soft paint complete the sense of refined luxury.

Bedroom: 1
Bathroom: 1
Garage
One-bedroom apartment in the Thea building, part of the new mixed complex Boka Place in Porto Montenegro. Kupatila: 2
Garaža
Dvosoban namješten dupleks penthouse od 179 m2 sa pogledom na more u zgradi Thea, naselje Boka.
Stan se sastoji od ulaznog hodnika, prostranog dnevnog boravka otvorenog tipa s visokim stropovima i mezaninom, trpezarije i kuhinje, pristupa velikoj terasi sa sjedećom garniturom, spavaće sobe, kupatila i unutarnjeg stepeništa koje vodi do drugog nivoa stana, koji se sastoji od glavne spavaće sobe s vlastitim kupatilom i terase s pogledom na more. Otvor iznad dnevnog boravka može se pretvoriti u treću spavaću sobu.
Cijena stana uključuje jedno garažno mjesto.
Boka Place je novi urbani kvart unutar Porto Montenegra, komercijalnog i stambenog centra s trgovinama, kafićima, kinom, hotelom i wellness centrom, zelenim vanjskim površinama, galerijama, svjetski poznatim modnim brendovima i privatnim rezidencijama. Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Garage space
The two-bedroom furnished duplex penthouse of 179 m2 with a sea view in Thea building, Boka place.

The opening above the living room can be converted into the third bedroom.
The price of the apartment includes one garage space.
Boka Place is the new urban quarter within Porto Montenegro, a commercial and residential center with shops, cafes, a cinema, a hotel and wellness hub, green outdoor areas, galleries, world-class fashion brands, and private residences. listing.description_text:
Namješten stan od 92 m2, sa dvije spavaće sobe i pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu Harmonija u Bečićima, Budva.
Stan se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka otvorenog plana sa trpezarijom, potpuno opremljene kuhinje, 1 kupatila, 2 spavaće sobe i velike terase sa pogledom na more i cijele Bečiće.
Stan je opremljen modernim namještajem, kvalitetnim kućanskim aparatima, split-sistemom klima uređaja, video interfonom, protivpožarnim sistemom, Smart-house sistemom, brzim internetom i kablovskom televizijom.
Stambeni kompleks Harmonia je luksuzni apartmanski kompleks smješten na najatraktivnijem mjestu Budvanske rivijere, između Bečića i Budve. Udaljenost kompleksa od mora je 100m, a od Starog grada u Budvi 2.5km.
listing.description_text_en:
Furnished apartment of 92 m2, with two bedrooms and sea view in the exclusive Harmonia residential complex in Bečići, Budva.
The apartment consists of a spacious open-plan living room with a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, 1 bathroom, 2 bedrooms and a large terrace with a view of the sea and the whole of Bečići.
The apartment is equipped with modern furniture, quality household appliances, split-system air conditioning, video intercom, fire alarm system, Smart-house system, high-speed internet and cable television.
The Harmonia residential complex is a luxurious apartment complex located in the most attractive place on the Budva Riviera, between Bečići and Budva. The distance of the complex from the sea is 100 m, and from the Old Town in Budva 2.5 km.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 117 m2 (105 m2 + 12 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2+1
Namješten
Garaža
Dobro pozicioniran dvosoban stan površine 117 m2 s pogledom na more u zgradi Ksenija.
Sastoji se od otvorenog dnevnog boravka s trpezarijom i potpuno opremljenom kuhinjom, dvije spavaće sobe sa kupatilom, gostinjskog toaleta i prostrane terase s prekrasnim pogledom na more.
Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten, a u cijenu je uključeno i jedno garažno mjesto.
Zgrada Ksenija je jedna od najpoželjnijih zgrada u kompleksu Porto Montenegro, zbog svog stila i kvaliteta gradnje, sa dva prekrasna bazena i pogledom na promenadu, ostrvo Sveti Marko i more.
Porto Montenegro je marina i luksuzni resort svjetske klase, sa ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, maloprodajnim objektima, hotelima itd. Sve zgrade imaju recepciju koja radi 24/7, organizovano održavanje, upravljanje objektima, obezbjeđenje, zajedničke bazene, teretane itd.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 117 m2 (105 m2 + 12 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2+1
Furnished
Garage space
Well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment measuring 117 m2 with a sea view in Ksenija building.
It consists of an open-plan living room with a dining area and fully equipped kitchen, two en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet and a spacious terrace with a stunning sea view.
The apartment is for sale fully furnished and has one garage space included in the price.
The Ksenija building is one of the most desirable buildings in the Porto Montenegro complex, due to its style and quality of construction, with 2 beautiful swimming pools and views of the city promenade, the island of Sveti Marko, and the sea.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina and luxury resort, with exclusive residences, retail, hotels, etc. All buildings have a 24/7 reception, organized maintenance, facility management, security, shared swimming pools, gyms, etc.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 154 m2 (98 m2 + terase 56 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Garaža
Prostrani dupleks penthaus od 154 m2 nalazi se u zgradi Alba, Boka Place, živoj urbanoj četvrti Porto Montenegra.
Na gornjem nivou su prostran otvoren dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, toalet za goste i izlaz na velike terase za boravak napolju i druženje.
Donji nivo je privatni spavaći dio, sa dvije udobne spavaće sobe, dva kupatila i direktnim izlazom na veliku terasu – idealan balans privatnosti i savremenog života.
Penthaus ima funkcionalan raspored, obilje prirodne svjetlosti i mnogo spoljnog prostora, pa je pogodan i kao glavni dom i kao luksuzna kuća za odmor.
Cijena stana uključuje jedno garažno mjesto.
Boka Place je najnovija višenamjenska četvrt Porto Montenegra, sa rezidencijama, prodavnicama, restoranima, kafićima, velnes sadržajima, zelenim javnim površinama i hotelom SIRO kompanije Kerzner International.
Na samo nekoliko minuta hoda od marine Porto Montenegro i šetališta uz more, Boka Place spaja moderan gradski život sa stilom života i sadržajima najprestižnije marine u Crnoj Gori.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 154 m2 (98 m2 + 56 m2 terraces)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Garage space
The spacious duplex penthouse of 154 m2 is located in Alba building, Boka Place, Porto Montenegro’s vibrant urban quarter.
The upper level consists of a spacious open-plan living room with dining area and kitchen, a guest toilet, and access to expansive terraces designed for outdoor living and entertaining.
The lower level is dedicated to the private sleeping area and offers two comfortable bedrooms, two bathrooms, and direct access to the large terrace, creating an ideal balance between privacy and contemporary living.
The penthouse offers a functional layout, abundant natural light, and extensive outdoor space, making it suitable both as a primary residence and a luxury holiday home.
The price of the apartment includes one garage space.
Boka Place is Porto Montenegro’s newest mixed-use neighborhood, featuring residences, retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, wellness facilities, green public spaces, and the SIRO Hotel by Kerzner International.
Located just a short walk from Porto Montenegro Marina and the waterfront promenade, Boka Place combines modern urban living with the lifestyle and amenities of Montenegro’s most prestigious marina destination.

listing.title_text: Stan Versa Residences sa dvije spavaće sobe
listing.description_text:
Površina: 100 m2 (90 m2 + terasa 10 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2
Garaža
Dvosoban stan u potpuno novoj stambenoj zgradi Versa u Porto Montenegru.
Stan će imati otvoren dnevni prostor i trpezariju sa kuhinjom, dvije spavaće sobe, dva kupatila i terasu. I iz dnevnog boravka i iz jedne spavaće sobe izlazi se na terasu sa pogledom na Boka Place.
Apartman će imati opremljenu kuhinju, kao i ugradni ormar
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Versa Residences je intimna kolekcija od 47 promišljeno osmišljenih stanova – studija, jednosobnih i dvosobnih – nastalih sa fokusom na ravnotežu, velnes i svakodnevnu udobnost. Stanari koriste prijatnu recepciju, bazen na podijumu sa zadivljujućim pogledom i dobro opremljenu teretanu na prvom spratu, a parking u kompleksu obezbjeđuje lak pristup i svakodnevnu udobnost.
Vero & Versa Residences su na pješačkoj udaljenosti od tržnog centra, međunarodne škole, medicinskog centra i raznih kafića i restorana internacionalne kuhinje, a more je udaljeno 50 m.
Pogodan plan plaćanja:
• Rezervacioni depozit: 10.000 €
• Predugovorni depozit: 10%, umanjen za rezervacioni depozit
• Prva rata: 30%, umanjena za predugovorni depozit
• Druga i treća rata, prema strukturi izgradnje: 25%
• Završna rata: 20% (kraj 2028. godine)
Cijena garažnog mjesta: 50.000 €
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 100 m2 (90 m2 + 10 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Garage
Two-bedroom apartment in Porto Montenegro brand new Versa residential building.
The apartment will consist of open space living and dining area with kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathroom and a terrace. Both living room and one bedroom offer access to the terrace overlooking Boka Place.
Apartment will have an equipped kitchen as well as built-in wardrobe.
The owners will have an option to choose fully bespoke furniture packages from Manor Interior Design, with fixed prices until June 2026.
Versa Residences is an intimate collection of 47 thoughtfully designed apartments, including studios, one- and two-bedroom homes, created with a focus on balance, wellness and everyday convenience. Residents can take advantage of an inviting reception area and a podium-level pool with stunning views and a well-equipped first-floor gym, while on-site parking ensures easy access and day-to-day comfort.
Vero & Versa Residences are located in walking distance to shopping mall, international school, medical center, various cafes and restaurants with international cuisine and distance to the sea is 50 m.
Convenient payment plan:
• Reservation deposit: 10,000 eur
• Pre-contract deposit: 10% reduced by Reservation deposit
• First installment: 30% reduced by Pre-Contract deposit
• Second and third installment, according to the development structure: 25%
• Final installment: 20% (end of 2028)
Price for garage space is 50,000 eur.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 53 m2 (40 m2 + 7 m2 terasa + 6 m2 E.U.R.)
Kupatila: 1
Garaža
Studio u Porto Montenegru, u potpuno novoj stambenoj zgradi Vero.
Apartman će se sastojati od otvorenog dnevnog boravka, trpezarije sa kuhinjom, jednog kupatila i terase.
Apartman će imati opremljenu kuhinju, kao i ugradni ormar
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Vero Residences obuhvata 155 modernih stanova, od studija do penthausa sa tri spavaće sobe, pažljivo dizajniranih da odgovaraju različitim stilovima života. Dizajniran sa fokusom na funkcionalnost i estetiku, Vero nudi mirni bazen na podijumu za opuštanje, četiri privatna ulaza radi optimalne praktičnosti i privatnosti, te elegantan centralni recepcijski prostor koji pruža udobnost i toplu dobrodošlicu — uz savremenu teretanu opremljenu vrhunskom fitnes opremom i sigurnu podzemnu garažu radi dodatne pogodnosti. Na prizemlju, pažljivo odabrani komercijalni prostori objedinjeni su sa buticima i vrhunskom gastronomijom, čime se dodatno unapređuje iskustvo života u zajednici.
Vero & Versa Residences se nalaze na pješačkoj udaljenosti od tržnog centra, međunarodne škole, medicinskog centra, raznih kafića i restorana sa internacionalnom kuhinjom, a udaljenost od mora je 50 m.
Pogodan plan plaćanja:
• Rezervacioni depozit: 10.000 €
• Predugovorni depozit: 10%, umanjen za rezervacioni depozit
• Prva rata: 30%, umanjena za predugovorni depozit
• Druga i treća rata, prema strukturi izgradnje: 25%
• Završna rata: 20% (kraj 2028. godine)
Cijena garažnog mjesta: 50.000 €
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 53 m2 (40 m2 + 7 m2 terrace + 6 m2 E.U.R.)
Bathrooms: 1
Garage
Studio apartment in Porto Montenegro brand new Vero residential building.
The apartment will consist of open space living and dining area with kitchen, one bathroom and a terrace.
Apartment will have an equipped kitchen as well as built-in wardrobe.
The owners will have an option to choose fully bespoke furniture packages from Manor Interior Design, with fixed prices until June 2026.
Vero Residences feature 155 modern homes, ranging from studio to three-bedroom penthouses, thoughtfully tailored to suit a wide range of lifestyles. Designed with both function and beauty in mind, Vero offers a serene podium-level pool for peaceful escapes, four private entrances for optimal convenience and privacy and an elegant central reception that provides both comfort and a warm welcome — along with a state-of-the-art gym equipped with premium fitness equipment and secure underground parking for added ease. On the ground floor, curated commercial spaces bring together boutique retail and upscale gastronomy, enhancing the community-focused living experience.
Vero & Versa Residences are located in walking distance to the shopping mall, international school, medical center, various cafes and restaurants with international cuisine and distance to the sea is 50 m.
Convenient payment plan:
• Reservation deposit: 10,000 eur
• Pre-contract deposit: 10% reduced by Reservation deposit
• First installment: 30% reduced by Pre-Contract deposit
• Second and third installment, according to the development structure: 25%
• Final installment: 20% (end of 2028)
Price for garage space is 50,000 eur.

listing.title_text: Apartman s 2 spavaće sobe na obali, Tara
listing.description_text:
Površina: 138 m2 (116 m2 + 22 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Jedinstven dvosoban stan od 138 m2 na obali mora u zgradi Tara, s pogledom na Trg Venecije i marinu.
Dobro je proporcioniran i sadrži prostrani dnevni boravak otvorenog plana s kuhinjom i trpezarijom, dvije spavaće sobe s vlastitim kupatilima, gostinjski WC i veliku terasu natkrivenu pergolom od 22 m2 s pogledom na more. Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten.
Zgrada Tara je jedna od najtraženijih rezidencija u Porto Montenegru, zahvaljujući svom dizajnu, završnim obradama, povoljnoj lokaciji u centru naselja i prekrasno uređenim terasama i zajedničkim prostorima.
Stanarima su na raspolaganju zajednički bazen s pogledom na more, teretana, recepcija i osiguranje 24/7, usluge konsijerža i upravljanje nekretninama.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 138 m2 (116 m2 + 22 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Unique waterfront two-bedroom apartment of 138 m2 in Tara building, overlooking Venice Square and marina.
It is well-proportioned and contains a spacious open-plan living room with a kitchen and dining area, two en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet, and a large pergola-covered terrace of 22 m2 with a sea view. The apartment is for sale fully furnished.
Tara building is one of the most sought-after residencies in Porto Montenegro, due to its design, final finishings, convenient location in the center of the Village, and beautiful landscaped terraces and common areas.
The residents have at their disposal a communal swimming pool with a sea view, a gym, reception and security 24/7, concierge services, and property management.

listing.title_text: Stan sa dvije spavaće sobe na obali, Baia
listing.description_text:
Površina stana: 147 m2
Unutrašnja površina: 114 m2
Terasa: 33 m2
Spavaće sobe: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Ekskluzivan stan u zgradi Baia, dijelu Regent Pool Club Residences. Stan ima dvije spavaće sobe, dva kupatila, toalet za goste, veliki dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom, kuhinju i veliku terasu sa otvorenim pogledom na marinu i more.
Zgrada Baia, druga završena zgrada u okviru Regent Pool Club Residences, jedan je od najnovijih djelova stambene ponude Porto Montenegra.
Ovi savremeni stanovi, svaki sa uređenim terasama, inspirisani su italijanskom rivijerom i imaju nesmetan pogled na more i planine.
Po modelu „hotelskog kondominijuma“, ove luksuzne rezidencije, uz mogućnost uključenja u program izdavanja, imaju direktan pristup uslugama i sadržajima hotela Regent sa pet zvjezdica i timu uprave na licu mjesta, koji na zahtjev vlasnika brine o održavanju i izdavanju.
listing.description_text_en:
Apartment area: 147 m2
Internal area: 114 m2
Terrace: 33 m2
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Exclusive apartment in Baia building, part of Regent Pool Club Residences. The apartment consists of two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a guest toilet, large living room with dining area, kitchen and a large terrace with open views of the marina and the sea.
Baia building, as the second finished building within Regent Pool Club Residences, is one of the newest parts of Porto Montenegro residential collection.
These contemporary apartments, each with landscaped terraces, are inspired by the Italian Riviera and have unobstructed sea and mountain views.
Based on the ‘hotel condominium’ model, these luxury residences for sale, with optional rental pool program, have direct access to the services and amenities of the five-star Regent Hotel and the onsite management team that can take care of all maintenance and rental administration at the owners’ request.

listing.title_text: Stan Baia sa tri spavaće sobe na obali
listing.description_text:
Površina stana: 220m2
Stambena površina: 146m2
Terasa: 74m2
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 3 + toalet
Sprat: 3
Ekskluzivan stan na 3. spratu zgrade Baia, novog krila Regent Pool Club Residences. Ima tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, veliki otvoren dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom, kuhinju i dvije velike terase – jednu sa otvorenim pogledom na bazen i more na istoku, drugu sa otvorenim pogledom na marinu i ulaz u Boku. Stan je potpuno namješten i spreman za useljenje.
Ovi savremeni, elegantni stanovi, svaki sa uređenim terasama, inspirisani su italijanskom rivijerom i imaju nesmetan pogled na more i planine – nesumnjivo vodeće nekretnine u Crnoj Gori.
Po modelu „hotelskog kondominijuma“, ove luksuzne rezidencije, uz mogućnost uključenja u program izdavanja, imaju direktan pristup brojnim uslugama i sadržajima hotela Regent sa pet zvjezdica i timu uprave na licu mjesta, koji na zahtjev vlasnika brine o održavanju i izdavanju.
Idealno za svakoga ko u Crnoj Gori želi da kupi po međunarodnim standardima
listing.description_text_en:
Apartment area: 220m2
Living area: 146m2
Terrace: 74m2
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3 + toilet
Floor: 3
Exclusive apartment on the 3rd floor of Baia building, the new wing of the Regent Pool Club Residences. The apartment has three ensuite bedrooms, large open space living room with dining area, kitchen and two large terraces, one of which has an open view of the pool and the sea from the east, and the other one also an open view of marina and the entrance of the Boka Bay. Apartment is fully furnished and ready for moving in.
These contemporary chic apartments, each with landscaped terraces, are inspired by the Italian Riviera and have unobstructed sea and mountain views offering undeniably the leading real estate in Montenegro.
Based on the ‘hotel condominium’ model, these luxury residences for sale, with optional rental pool program, have direct access to the extensive services and amenities of the five-star Regent Hotel and the onsite management team that can take care of all maintenance and rental administration at the owners’ request.
Ideal for anyone looking for international standards to buy in Montenegro

listing.title_text: Penthouse na rivi Tara, Porto Montenegro
listing.description_text:
Površina: 357 m2 (187 m2 + 170 m2 terase)
Spavaće sobe: 4
Kupatila: 3 + 1
Garaža
Penthouse od 357 m2 sa privatnim bazenom na krovnoj terasi i panoramskim pogledom na more i marinu, zgrada Tara.
Stan se sastoji od velikog dnevnog boravka otvorenog tipa s kaminom i izlazom na terasu s panoramskim pogledom na more, trpezarije, kuhinje, tri spavaće sobe, tri kupatila i velike radne sobe s izlazom na drugu terasu s bočnim pogledom na more.
Na krovu zgrade nalazi se privatna terasa s bazenom i prostorom za opuštanje s panoramskim pogledom na more.
Jedno garažno mjesto je uključeno u cijenu, dok je preuzimanje namještaja predmet posebnog dogovora.
Zgrada Tara se nalazi iza Trga Venecije, u blizini hotela Regent sa 5 zvjezdica.
Porto Montenegro je marina svjetske klase koja nudi ekskluzivne rezidencije, maloprodajne objekte i restorane.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 357 m2 (187 m2 + 170 m2 terraces)
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 3 + 1
Garage space
Penthouse of 357 m2 with a private pool on the roof terrace and panoramic views of the sea and marina, Tara building.
The apartment consists of a large open-plan living room with a fireplace and access to a terrace with panoramic sea views, a dining room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a large study with access to another terrace with side sea views.
On the roof of the building, there is a private terrace with a swimming pool and a relaxation area boasting a panoramic sea view.
One garage space is included in the price, while the furniture take-over is subject to a separate agreement.
The Tara building is situated behind Venice Square, near the Regent 5-star Hotel.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina that features exclusive residences, retail outlets, and restaurants.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 247 m2 (147 m2 + 100 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 2+1
Garažna mjesta: 2
Trosobni penthaus površine 247 m2 sa direktnim pristupom bazenu na krovu u zgradi Zeta.
Apartman se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka sa kuhinjom i izlazom na terasu pokrivenu pergolom i bazenom na krovu, tri spavaće sobe sa kupatilom, gostinskog WC-a sa vešerajem, te izlazom na još jednu terasu sa pogledom na more.
Cijena uključuje dva parking mjesta, sav ugradni i pokretni namještaj, bijelu tehniku i tehničku opremu.
KARAKTERISTIKE
Pogled na more i planine
24-satno obezbjeđenje i recepcija
Zajednički bazen i teretana u zgradi
Blizina svih sadržaja (bankomat, apoteka, frizerski salon, dnevni spa centar, trgovina)
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 247 m2 (147 m2 + 100 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 2+1
Garage spaces: 2
Three-bedroom penthouse of 247 m2 with direct access to the rooftop pool in the Zeta building.
The apartment consists of a spacious living room with a kitchen and access to a terrace covered by a pergola and a rooftop pool, three en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet with a laundry room, access to another terrace with a sea view.
The price includes two garage spaces and all built-in and movable furniture as well as white goods and technical equipment.
CHARACTERISTICS
Sea and mountain view
24-hour security and reception
Shared swimming pool and gym in the building
Close to all amenities (ATM, pharmacy, hair salon, day spa, store)
